rows.output: "Every minute, the ambulance brings in a dead body."
rows.reference: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.

rows.source: Omi tó mọ́ ṣọ̀wọ́n."
rows.output: The clear water flows."
rows.reference: Clean water is scarce."

rows.source: A rí àwọn olùgbé tó ń padà lọ sí ilé wọn tó ti bàjẹ́ láti mú ohun tí wọ́n bá lè rí mú nínú ẹrù wọn.
rows.output: We saw the inhabitants returning to their ruined homes to gather whatever they could find in their belongings.
rows.reference: Residents were seen returning to their destroyed homes, picking through waterlogged belongings, trying to salvage anything they could find.

rows.source: Ọ̀gọ̀ọ̀rọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn ló farapa nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ilẹ̀ mímì tí agbára rẹ̀ tó 7.5
rows.output: More than 100 people were injured in a 7.5 magnitude earthquake that struck the island.
rows.reference: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals, damaged by the magnitude 7.5 quake, were overwhelmed.

rows.source: Díẹ̀ nínú àwọn tó fara káṣá nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yìí, èyí tí Dwi Harris tí ó ṣìṣe léjìká ,tí egun ẹ̀yìn rẹ̀ sì kán sinmi ní iwájú ilé ìwòsàn Palu's Army, níbi tí àwọn aláìsàn ti ń rí ìtọ́jú gbà.
rows.output: Some of those who were injured in this incident, including Dwi Harris, who was shot in the back, are resting in the Palu's Army Hospital, where patients are receiving treatment.
rows.reference: Some of the injured, including Dwi Haris, who suffered a broken back and shoulder, rested outside Palu's Army Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to continuing strong aftershocks.

rows.source: Pẹ̀lú omijé ni Dwi fi ń ròyìn ìṣẹ̀lẹ ilẹ̀ mímì tí ó ká òun, ọmọbìnrin àti iyawo re mọ́ àjà-ile karùn-ún ní hòtẹ́ẹ̀lì.
rows.output: With tears, Dwi recounted the earthquake that had struck her, her daughter, and her husband's fifth wedding anniversary at the hotel.
rows.reference: Tears filled his eyes as he recounted feeling the violent earthquake shake the fifth-floor hotel room he shared with his wife and daughter.

rows.source: A ò ráyè kankan láti sá àsálà fún ẹ̀mí wa.
rows.output: We have no right to run away from our responsibilities for the sake of our own lives.
rows.reference: "There was no time to save ourselves.

rows.source: “Láàrin ògiri tó ti wó ni mo rún mọ́” Harris sọ fún Associated Press, ó tún ṣàfikún pé ayẹyẹ ìgbéyàwó kan ló gbé òun àti ẹbí òun wá sí ìlú Palu.
rows.output: "Among the ruins, I ran to them," Harris told the Associated Press, adding that a wedding ceremony had brought him and his family to the town of Palu.
rows.reference: I was squeezed into the ruins of the wall, I think," Haris told Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for a wedding.

rows.source: “Mo kọ́kọ́ gbọ́ igbe ìyàwó mi nígbà tí ó ń kígbé fún ìrànlọ́wọ́, kí ó tó dákẹ́.
rows.output: I first heard my wife's screams when she was calling for help, before she became silent.
rows.reference: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then silence.

rows.source: Mí ò mọ ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ sí ìyàwó àti ọmọ mi
rows.output: I don't know what happened to my wife and child.
rows.reference: I don't know what happened to her and my child.

rows.source: Mo ní ìrètí pé kò sí ohunkóhun tó ṣe wọ́n”
rows.output: I hope that nothing has happened to them.
rows.reference: I hope they are safe."

rows.source: Aṣojú ìjọba US ní orílẹ̀èdè China fẹ̀sùn kan orílẹ̀èdè náà pé ó ń ṣe ìpalára fún àwọn orílẹ̀èdè mìíràn pẹ̀lú pípolówó ẹ̀tàn.
rows.output: The US government representative in China accused the country of harming other nations with deceptive marketing.
rows.reference: U.S. ambassador accuses China of 'bullying' with 'propaganda ads'

rows.source: Lẹ́yìn ọ̀sẹ̀ kan tí ìwé ìròyìn fún ìjọba China gbé ìròyìn olójúùwé mẹ́rin kan jáde nínú ìwé ìròyìn kan ní US. Ìròyìn náà ṣe àtòólẹ̀ àǹfààní tó wà láàrin òwò láàrin China àti US, èyí tí aṣojú ìjọba náà na ìka àbùkù kan China pé ó ń fi àwọn ìwé ìròyìn orílẹ̀èdè Amẹ́ríkà tan àwọn ènìyàn.
rows.output: After a week of the Chinese government's publication of four editorials in a US newspaper, the Chinese government's ambassador to the US criticized the newspaper for publishing pro-American propaganda.
rows.reference: A week after an official Chinese newspaper ran a four-page ad in a U.S. daily touting the mutual benefits of U.S.-China trade, the U.S. ambassador to China accused Beijing of using the American press to spread propaganda.

rows.source: U.S. Ààrẹ orílẹ̀èdè U.S. Donald Trump ní Ọjọ́rú tó kọjá tọ́ka sí ìròyìn tí China gbé jáde nínú ìwé ìròyìn Des Moines Register- ilé-iṣẹ́ ìwé ìròyìn tí ń tà jùlọ ní ìpínlẹ̀ Iowa fẹ̀sùn kan China pé ó ń gbìyànjú láti dásí ètò ìdìbò ilé fún ilé amòfin tí yóò wáyé ní ọjọ́ kẹfà oṣù kọọkànlá. Orílẹ̀èdè China kọ̀ jálẹ̀ pé àwọn kò mọwọ́-mẹsẹ̀ nípa ẹ̀sùn náà.
rows.output: On December 5, U.S. President Donald Trump referred to a report from the Chinese government published in the Des Moines Register, a newspaper with the largest circulation in the state of Iowa, accusing China of attempting to interfere with the upcoming midterm elections. China denied the allegations, stating that they were unaware of any such interference.
rows.reference: U.S. President Donald Trump last Wednesday referred to the China Daily's paid supplement in the Des Moines Register - the state of Iowa's biggest selling newspaper - after accusing China of seeking to meddle in the Nov. 6 U.S. congressional elections, a charge China denies.

rows.source: Ibu ẹnu atẹlu Trump ti Beijing n gbiyanju lati dasi ninu idibo U.S saami si ohun ti awọn osisẹ U.S sọ fun Reuters jẹ ipele tuntun ninu irusoke ipolongo ibo lọdọ Washington lati funmọ China.
rows.output: Trump's trade war with Beijing is trying to get into the U.S. election campaign, as reported by Reuters, is a new level of escalation in the trade war between Washington and Beijing.
rows.reference: Trump's accusation that Beijing was trying to meddle in U.S. elections marked what U.S. officials told Reuters was a new phase in an escalating campaign by Washington to put pressure on China.

rows.source: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ kìí ṣe ohun àràmọ̀ndà kí àwọn ìjọba òkèèrè ṣe ìpolówó fún ìlọsíwájú ọrọ̀ ajé, rògbòdìyàn nípa ọrọ̀ ajé wà láàrin Beijing ati Washington, èyí tí ó sì fà á kí àwọn méjèèjì gbé owó lórí àwọn ọjà tí ó ń wọlé láti orílẹ̀èdè kejì.
rows.output: While it is not a secret that foreign governments promote economic progress, there is a debate between Beijing and Washington about the economy, which has led both to impose tariffs on imports from the other country.
rows.reference: While it is normal for foreign governments to place advertisements to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently locked in an escalating trade war that has seen them level rounds of tariffs on each other's imports.

rows.source: Àwọn onímọ̀ lórílèedè U.S. wòye pé China ṣe àfikún owó lè ọjà tó ń wọlé sí U.S. láti orílẹ̀èdè China pàápàá jùlọ ní àwọn ìpínlẹ̀ bíi Iowa tí ó gbárùkù Trump àti ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú rẹ̀.
rows.output: US experts believe that China has added a significant amount of currency to the US market, particularly in states like Iowa that Trump and his party have targeted.
rows.reference: China's retaliatory tariffs early in the trade war were designed to hit exporters in states such as Iowa that supported Trump's Republican Party, Chinese and U.S. experts have said.

rows.source: Aṣojú ìjọba U.S. ni China àti Gómìnà tẹ́lẹ̀ rí fún ìpínlẹ̀ Iowa, ẹni tí ó ń ta ohun ògbìn sí China jù, Terry Branstad sọ pé China ṣe ìpalára fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́, okoòwò àti àgbẹ̀ nílẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.output: The U.S. Ambassador to China and former Governor of Iowa, who has sold more agricultural products to China than anyone, Terry Branstad, said that China has harmed American workers, businesses and farmers.
rows.reference: Terry Branstad, the U.S. ambassador to China and the former longtime governor of Iowa, a major exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing had hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.

rows.source: Branstad wòye nínú ìwé tí ó kọ sínú ìwé ìròyìn Des Moines Register ní ọjọ́ Àìkú pé China ti sa gbogbo ipa wọn láti ṣe ìpolongo ẹ̀tàn nínú àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ìròyìn ní Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.output: Branstad wrote in an op-ed column in the Des Moines Register on Monday that China has used its influence to spread propaganda in American media.
rows.reference: China, Branstad wrote in an opinion piece in Sunday's Des Moines Register, "is now doubling down on that bullying by running propaganda ads in our own free press."

rows.source: "Ìjọba China ń ṣe àmúlò ètò ìròyìn tí kò ní ìpalára láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba tí ó wà ní Amẹ́ríkà láti sanwó ṣe ìpolongo ẹ̀tàn àti irọ́ nínú ìwé ìròyìn Des Moines Register,” ni ohun tí Branstad kọ.
rows.output: "The Chinese government is implementing a non-toxic propaganda program from the American government to pay for ads in the Des Moines Register," wrote Branstad.
rows.reference: "In disseminating its propaganda, China's government is availing itself of America's cherished tradition of free speech and a free press by placing a paid advertisement in the Des Moines Register," Branstad wrote.

rows.source: "Ó tún tẹ̀síwájú pé “Lódì kejì ẹ̀wẹ̀, kò fi bẹ́ẹ̀ sí àwọn alátakò tàbí ààfihàn èrò àwọn ará China lórí irúfẹ́ ọwọ́ ti ìjọba fi mú ètò ọrọ̀ ajé. Èyí rí bẹ́ẹ̀ nítorí abẹ́ ìṣàkóso ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Chinese Communist Party ni àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ìròyìn wà.
rows.output: "It also continued that "Secondly, there is no evidence of any opposition or dissent among the Chinese people regarding the type of economic system that the government has chosen. This is because under the control of the Chinese Communist Party, the media outlets are."
rows.reference: "In contrast, at the newsstand down the street here in Beijing, you will find limited dissenting voices and will not see any true reflection of the disparate opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's troubling economic trajectory, given that media is under the firm thumb of the Chinese Communist Party," he wrote.

rows.source: Ó tún fikún un pé ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ògbóntarìgì ilé ìwé ìròyìn ní orílẹ̀èdè China kọ̀ jálẹ̀ láti tẹ iṣẹ́ òun sínú ìwé ìròyìn wọn bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Branstad kò dárúkọ ìwé ìròyìn náà ní pàtó.
rows.output: He also added that one of the editors of a Chinese newspaper had written an article about his work, even though Branstad did not mention the newspaper specifically.
rows.reference: He added that "one of China's most prominent newspapers dodged the offer to publish" his article, although he did not say which newspaper.

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ Ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì ń ya àwọn obìnrin kúrò pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ Kavanaugh, Àwọn Onímọ̀ kìlọ̀
rows.output: The Republican Party is splitting over the issue of Kavanaugh, Experts warn
rows.reference: Republicans Alienating Women Voters Ahead of Midterms With Kavanaugh Debacle, Analysts Warn

rows.source: Pẹ̀lú bí ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn àgbà ọ̀jẹ̀ olóṣèlú ẹgbẹ́ republican ṣe ń gbárùkù ẹni tí wọ́n yàn ní ilé ẹjọ́ tí ó ga jù lọ pẹ̀lú gbogbo àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìfipábóbìnrin lòpọ̀, àwọn onímọ̀ tí ń kìlọ̀ pé ọ̀rọ̀ yìí yóò lẹ́yìn pàápàá jùlọ láti ọwọ́ àwọn obìnrin nínú ètò ìdìbò áàrin táàmù.
rows.output: With many of the older members of the Republican Party now endorsing the candidate who was elected with a large number of sexual harassment charges, experts are warning that this trend will be especially pronounced from the women in the upcoming midterm elections.
rows.reference: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.

rows.source: Ọ̀rọ̀ náà ti fa ọ̀pọ̀lọ̀pọ̀ rúkèrúdò, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì sì ń takú àwọn yóò tún dìbò fún àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ wọn.
rows.output: The situation has caused a lot of unrest, and Republican politicians are pressuring their members to vote for their candidates.
rows.reference: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.

rows.source: Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n nínú ẹ̀kọ́ ìṣèlú ní Maxwell School tí ó wà ní Yunifásítì Syracuse Grant Reheer ṣọ fún àwọn ìwé ìròyìn The Hill lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta pé ọ̀rọ̀ náà yóò lẹ́yìn.
rows.output: A professor of political science at the Maxwell School at Syracuse University, Grant Reheer, defended the press in an article for The Hill on Thursday that the story would follow.
rows.reference: Those things can't be walked back," Grant Reeher, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School told The Hill for an article published Saturday.

rows.source: Reheer sọ pé òun kò rò bóyá ìgbésẹ̀ tí Amòfin Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) nípa pípè àjọ FBI láti wá ṣe ìwádìí àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan Kavanaugh yóò tó láti pẹ̀tù sọ́kàn àwọn olùdìbò tí inú ń bí lọ́wọ́ lórí ọ̀rọ̀ náà.
rows.output: Reheer said he did not think the action taken by Senator Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) of calling the FBI to investigate the allegations against Kavanaugh would be enough to sway the voters who were already inclined to vote against him.
rows.reference: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.

rows.source: "“Àwọn obìnrin ò ní gbàgbé ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ ní àná, wọn kò ní gbàgbé rẹ̀ lónìí, wọn kò sì ní gbàgbé rẹ̀ nínú ètò ìdìbò tí yóò wáyé ní oṣù kọọkànlá” ni ohun tí Karine Jean-Pierre, olùbádámọ̀ràn àgbà àti agbẹnusọ gbogbo fún ẹgbẹ́ MoveOn sọ lọ́jọ Ẹtì, èyí tí ó sì jẹyọ nínú ìwé ìròyìn Washington, D.C.
rows.output: "Women will not forget what happened yesterday, they will not forget it today, and they will not forget it in the electoral process that will take place in November," said Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior advisor and spokesperson for the MoveOn organization, on Tuesday, as reported in the Washington, D.C.
rows.reference: "Women are not going to forget what happened yesterday - they are not going to forget it tomorrow and not in November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn said on Friday, according to the Washington, D.C. newspaper.

rows.source: Oṣù kọọkànlá ń bọ̀! Ní ohun tí àwọn afẹ̀hónúhàn ń ké bí wọ́n ṣe fi ìtaara wọn hàn ní ilé Aṣòfin pẹ̀lú bí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì tí ó wà ní ìgbìmọ̀ tó ń ṣàkóso ọ̀rọ̀ ilé ẹjọ́ ṣe ń tẹ̀síwájú láti yan Kavanaugh sípò. The Mic jẹ́ kí ó yé wa pé èyí wáyé lẹ́yìn ẹ̀rí dọ́kítà Christine Blasey Ford. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic ní ó ń jọ́bọ̀ ìròyìn.
rows.output: November is coming! The Mic is aware of the anxiety of the protesters as they show their determination in the Capitol with the Republican senators on the Judiciary Committee continuing to vote in favor of Kavanaugh. The Mic is informed that this happened after the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford. Christine Blasey Ford, the Mic is aware of her job, reporting the news.
rows.reference: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.

rows.source: Onímọ̀ ìṣèlú Stu Rothenberg sọ “Ìmọ̀sílára kò ní í sí lára àwọn ènìyàn, èyí yóò sì mú wọn dìbò”
rows.output: Political scientist Stu Rothenberg said "Sentiment is not in the people, and it will vote them out"
rows.reference: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.

rows.source: Àwọn ènìyàn tilẹ̀ ti ń sọ pé àwọn kò lè dúró kí ọjọ́ ìdìbò dé.
rows.output: People have been saying that they can't wait for the election day.
rows.reference: "People are saying it's already been high; that's true.

rows.source: Ó ṣeéṣe kí ìmọ̀sílára pọ̀ sí pàápàá jùlọ láàrin àwọn obìnrin tí ó wà ní ìgbèríko àti àwọn ọmọbìnrin láàrin ọmọ ọdún méjìdínlógún sí óòkandínlọ́gbọ̀n tí wọ́n ò nífẹ̀ẹ́ ààrẹ, síbẹ̀ tí wọ́n kìí dìbò.”
rows.output: It is possible that the sentiment is more pronounced among rural women and among girls aged 18 to 29 who are not in favor of the president, but who do not vote.
rows.reference: But it could be higher, particularly among swing women voters in the suburbs and younger voters, 18- to 29-year-olds, who while they don't like the president, often don't vote."

rows.source: Kí Ford tó jẹ́rìí ní gbangba nípa ẹ̀sùn ìfipábóbìnrin lòpọ̀ tí ó fi kan Kavanaugh ni àwọn onímọ̀ ti ń kìlọ̀ pé ó ṣeéṣe kí yíyan Kavanaugh sípò bu ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì lọ́wọ́.
rows.output: Before Ford publicly confirmed the sexual assault allegations against Kavanaugh, experts were warning that the Republican Party could be damaged by the nomination.
rows.reference: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.

rows.source: “Ọ̀rọ̀ yìí ti dá yánpọyánrin kalẹ̀ fún ẹgbẹ́ wa” ni ohun tí Michael Steele tí ó fìgbà kan jẹ́ alága fún ìgbìmọ̀ gbogbogbò ní ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì sọ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá gẹ́gẹ́ bí NBC News ṣe sọ.
rows.output: "This has been a very difficult week for our party" is what Michael Steele, the former chairman of the Republican National Committee, told NBC News last week.
rows.reference: "This has become a muddled mess for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, early last week, according to NBC News.

rows.source: “Ọ̀rọ̀ yìí kìí ṣe nípa bóyá àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì yan Kavanaugh sípò nìkan, ó tún nííṣe pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ tí ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Rìpúbílíkáànì fi mú ọ̀rọ̀ náà àti ọwọ́ tí wọ́n fi mú Ford” Olùdarí ẹgbẹ́ tó ń ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ẹgbẹ́ ìṣèlú Dẹ́mókírààtì Priorities USA, Guy Cecil ló sọ èyí fún ilé iṣẹ́ ìròyìn náà.
rows.output: "This is not just about whether Republican voters chose Kavanaugh, but also about the hand that Republican voters gave to the party and the hand that the party gave to Ford," said Guy Cecil, the executive director of Priorities USA, a Democratic group, in an interview with the news organization.
rows.reference: "It's just not about the committee vote or the final vote or whether Kavanaugh is put on the bench, it's also about the way Republicans have handled this and how they have treated her," Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, a group that helps to elect Democrats, pointed out to the news channel.

rows.source: Síbẹ̀, èrò àwọn ọmọ Amẹ́ríkà pín sí méjì lórí ọ̀rọ̀ náà pẹ̀lú bí wọn kò mọ ẹni tí ó yẹ kí wọ́n gbàgbọ́ nínú Kavanaugh àti Ford.
rows.output: However, American public opinion is divided on the issue with how they trust Kavanaugh and Ford.
rows.reference: However, Americans appear to be somewhat split over who to believe in the wake of Ford's and Kavanaugh's testimonies, with slightly more siding with the latter.

rows.source: Ìdìbò afèròhàn tí YouGov gbé kalẹ̀ fi hàn pé ìdá mọ́kànlelógoji nínú àwọn tó kópa nínú ètò ìdìbò náà sọ pé àwọn gba Ford gbọ́ nígbà tí ìdá márùndínlógójì ló sọ pé àwọn gba Kavanaugh gbọ́.
rows.output: A survey conducted by YouGov found that 51% of respondents said they had heard of Ford, while 45% said they had heard of Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: A new poll from YouGov shows that 41 percent of respondents definitely or probably believed Ford's testimony, while 35 percent said they definitely or probably believed Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Ìdá méjìdínlógójì ló sọ pé àwọn ní ìgbàgbọ́ pé ó ṣeéṣe kí Kavanaugh ti parọ́ nínú ẹ̀rí rẹ̀ nígbà tí ìdá ọgbọ̀n ló gbàgbọ́ pé ó ṣeéṣe kí Ford ti parọ́ nínú ẹ̀rí tirẹ̀ bákan náà.
rows.output: 38 percent said they believed that Kavanaugh lied under oath, while 30 percent said they believed that Ford lied under oath as well.
rows.reference: Additionally, 38 percent said they thought Kavanaugh has probably or definitely lied during his testimony, while just 30 percent said the same about Ford.

rows.source: The Guardian ròyìn pé lẹ́yìn tí amòfin Flake ké sí àjọ FBI, ìwádìí ti ń lọ lọ́wọ́ lórí ẹ̀sùn tí Ford and afẹ̀sùkan mìíràn Deborah Ramírez fi kan Kavanaugh.
rows.output: The Guardian reported that after attorney Ford's letter to the FBI, the investigation was ongoing into the allegations against Kavanaugh and his friend Deborah Ramirez.
rows.reference: After the push from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating the allegations brought forward by Ford as well as at least one other accuser, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.

rows.source: Ford jẹ́rìí níwájú ìgbìmọ̀ tó ń rí sí ilé ẹjọ́ nílé Aṣòfin pé Kavanaugh mú ọtí yó, ó sì fipá bá òun lòpọ̀ nígbà tí òun pé ọmọ ọdún mẹ́tàdínlógún.
rows.output: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee that Kavanaugh had sexually assaulted her when she was 15 years old.
rows.reference: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee under oath last week that Kavanaugh drunkenly assaulted her at the age of 17.

rows.source: Ramirez ṣàlàyé pé Kavanaugh ṣí nǹkan ọmọkùnrin rẹ̀ fún òun láti rí nígbà tí wọ́n ń dìjọ kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní Yale. Èyí ṣẹlẹ̀ ni patí kan tí wọ́n lọ láàrin ọdún 1980 síwájú sí i.
rows.output: Ramirez explained that Kavanaugh had opened his son's locker for him to see when they were studying at Yale. This happened in a year between 1980 and 1983.
rows.reference: Ramirez alleges that the Supreme Court nominee exposed his genitals to her while they attended a party during their time studying at Yale in the 1980s.

rows.source: Olùdásílẹ Ìtàkùǹ Àyélujára ń gbèrò láti Bẹ̀rẹ̀ Íntánẹ̀ẹ̀tì Tuntun kan láti lé Mú Google àti Facebook
rows.output: The Internet Archive is considering starting a new Internet to replace Google and Facebook.
rows.reference: The Inventor of the World Wide Web Plans to Start a New Internet to Take on Google and Facebook

rows.source: Tim Berners-Lee, olùdásílẹ̀ Ìtàkùn ayélujára, ń ṣe ifilọ́lẹ̀ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ kan tí ó máa jẹ́ orogún pẹ̀lú Facebook, Amazon àti Google.
rows.output: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a new project that will compete with Facebook, Amazon, and Google.
rows.reference: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a startup that seeks to rival Facebook, Amazon and Google.

rows.source: Iṣẹ́ àkànṣe Ògbóǹtarìgì onímọ̀ ẹ̀rọ, Inrupt, jẹ́ ilé iṣẹ́ tí ó dúró lórí i orísun ìpìlẹ̀ iṣẹ́ Berners-Lee.
rows.output: The World Wide Web Consortium's (W3C) Inrupt project is a company that is based on the original work of Tim Berners-Lee.
rows.reference: The technology legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds off of Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.

rows.source: Solid fààyè gba àwọn aṣàmúlò láti yan ibi tí dátà wọn yóò di fífipamọ́ sí àti àwọn ènìyàn wo ní wọ́n le ráyè sí àti irú ìwífún tí wọ́n le ráyè sí.
rows.output: Solid fààyè gba àwọn aṣàmúlò láti yan ibi tí dátà wọn yóò di fífipamọ́ sí àti àwọn ènìyàn wo ní wọ́n le ráyè sí àti irú ìwífún tí wọ́n le ráyè sí.
rows.reference: Solid allows users to choose where their data is stored and what people are allowed to have access to what information.

rows.source: Nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò pẹ́lú ilé iṣẹ́ Fast, Berners-Lee ṣàwàdà pé èròńgbà lẹ́yìn Inrupt ni láti le “jẹ gàba lórí ayé.”
rows.output: In an interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee explained that the idea behind Inrupt was to "be able to get on the world stage."
rows.reference: In an exclusive interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee joked that the intent behind Inrupt is "world domination."

rows.source: “A gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe báyìí," ó sọ bẹ́ẹ̀ nípa ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ náà.
rows.output: "We must do this now," he said, referring to the start of the project.
rows.reference: "We have to do it now," he said of the startup.

rows.source: "Ó jẹ́ àkókò onítàn."
rows.output: "It is a time of change."
rows.reference: "It's a historical moment."

rows.source: Ìṣàfilọ́̀lẹ̀ náà ń lo ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ Solid láti fààyègba àwọn ènìyàn láti ṣẹ̀dá “ilé ìtàjà dátà adáni lórí ayélujára” tàbí POD.
rows.output: The project uses Solid's technology to enable people to create their own "personal data store online" or POD.
rows.reference: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data store" or a POD.

rows.source: Ó le ní àwọn àtòkọ olùbásọ̀rọ̀, ohun-àti-ṣe, kàlẹ́ńdà, ibi ìpamọ́ orin àti àwọn irinṣẹ́ àdáni àti àfyṣiṣẹ́ mìràn.
rows.output: It can have contact lists, to-do lists, calendars, music storage, and other personal tools and widgets.
rows.reference: It can contain contact lists, to-do lists, calendar, music library and other personal and professional tools.

rows.source: Ó dábí Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack àti Spotify tí gbogbo wọ́n wà nílẹ̀ lórí aṣawákiri ní àṣìkò kannáà.
rows.output: He also recommended Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack, and Spotify, all of which were already available on the browser at the time.
rows.reference: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and all at the same time.

rows.source: Ohun tí ó dá yàtọ̀ nípa ilé ìtàjà dátà àdáni ayelujára pé aṣàmúlò ló kù sí lọ́wọ́ láti mọ ẹni tí ó le ráyèsí àti irú ìwífún tó le ráyèsí.
rows.output: The unique thing about the online data center is that it is not known who can access and what information can be accessed.
rows.reference: What's unique about the personal online data store is that it is completely up to the user who can access what kind of information.

rows.source: Ilé iṣẹ́ pè ní “Ìrónilágbára àdáni nípaṣẹ̀ dátà.”
rows.output: The company is called "Private Enterprise Data Processing."
rows.reference: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data."

rows.source: Èròńgbà fún Inrupt, gẹ́gẹ́bí Olùdásílẹ̀ ilé iṣẹ́ náà John Bruce ṣe sọ, ni pé ó wá fún ilé iṣẹ̀ láti mú àwọn ohun àmúlò, ìlànà àti àwọn ọgbọ́n àtinúdá láti ṣèrànwọ́ láti mú kí Solid wà nílẹ̀ fún gbogbo ènìyàn.
rows.output: The purpose of Inrupt, as stated by the founder of the company John Bruce, is to bring practical, proven methods and tools to help Solid become a reality for everyone.
rows.reference: The idea for Inrupt, according to the company's CEO John Bruce, is for the company to bring resources, process and appropriate skills to help make Solid available to everyone.

rows.source: Ilé iṣẹ́ náà ní Berners-Lee, Bruce, ètò ìpèsè ààbò tí IBM rà, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ fúngbàdíẹ̀ tí wọ́n gbà láti ṣiṣẹ́ lórí iṣẹ́ àkànṣe náà, àti àwùjọ àwọn akọkóòdù tí wọ́n jẹ́ olùfarajìn.
rows.output: The company was funded by IBM, Berners-Lee, Bruce, and a number of employees who were hired to work on the project, and a community of volunteers who were passionate about the project.
rows.reference: The company currently consists of Berners-Lee, Bruce, a security platform bought by IBM, some on-staff developers contracted to work on the project, and a community of volunteer coders.

rows.source: Bẹ́rẹ̀ láti ọ̀ṣẹ̀ yìí, àwọn aṣàmúàgbà ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ káàkiri àgbáyé le ṣldá àwọn ìṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ tiwọ́n ní àkàtà wọ́n nípa lílo àwọn irínṣẹ́ tó wà nílẹ̀ lórí wẹ́ẹ̀bù Inrupt.
rows.output: From this point on, global tech giants will be able to create their own decentralized applications by using tools available on the Inrupt website.
rows.reference: Starting this week, technology developers around the world could create their own decentralized apps using the tools available on the Inrupt website.

rows.source: Berners-Lee sọ pé òun àti àwọn akẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ kò bá “Facebook àti Google” sọ̀rọ̀ nípa bóyá tàbí ki wọ́n ṣètò ìyípadà pátápátá níbi gbogbo àwòṣe òkòwò wọn tí máa yípadà tàbí kí ó soríkodò láìròtẹ́lẹ̀.
rows.output: Berners-Lee said that he and his colleagues were not talking to "Facebook and Google" about whether or not to make a fundamental change in their business model that would be transparent or not.
rows.reference: Berners-Lee said that he and his team are not talking to "Facebook and Google about whether or not to introduce a complete change where all their business models are completely upended overnight.

rows.source: "Àwa kò bèèrè fún ìyànda wọn."
rows.output: "We do not ask for their mercy."
rows.reference: "We are not asking their permission."

rows.source: Nínú àtljíṣẹ́ lórí Medium tí wọ́n tẹ̀jáde ní sátidé, Berners-Lee kọ lórí Inrupts pé “àfojúsùn ni láti pèsè ohun àmúṣagbara olókòwò àti àyíká ilegbèè láti ṣèrànwọ́ ìdáàbòbò àti àmúyẹ wẹ́ẹ̀bù tí a fi Solid ṣe.”
rows.output: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote on Inrupts that "the goal is to provide a robust commercial and technical infrastructure to help secure and enable the web that is built with Solid."
rows.reference: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote that Inrupt's "mission is to provide commercial energy and an ecosystem to help protect the integrity and quality of the new web built on Solid."

rows.source: Ní 1994, Berners-Lee tí Ítánẹ̀ẹ̀tì padà nígbàtí ó dá ilé iṣẹ́ wẹ́ẹ̀bù ayélujára sílẹ̀ ní ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ ní Massachusetts.
rows.output: In 1994, Berners-Lee returned to the Internet when he founded the World Wide Web Company at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
rows.reference: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he established the World Wide Web Consortium at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

rows.source: Ní àwọn oṣù bí díẹ̀ ṣẹ́yìn, Berners-Lee ni ó ti jẹ́ ẹní àwòkọ́ṣe níbi ìjíròrò aláìṣègbè.
rows.output: In the past few months, Berners-Lee has been a regular at the open forum discussions.
rows.reference: In recent months, Berners-Lee has been an influential voice in the net neutrality debate.

rows.source: Kódà lákòókò ìṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ Inrupt, Berners-Lee sì máa jẹ́ Olùdásílẹ̀ àti Olùdarí ilé iṣẹ́ wẹ́ẹ̀bù ayélujára, ìpìlẹ̀ Wẹ́ẹ̀bù àti ilé iṣẹ́ Dátà Àjọlò.
rows.output: Even during the Inrupt launch, Berners-Lee would remain the founder and director of the World Wide Web, the foundation of the Web and the World Wide Web Consortium.
rows.reference: Even while launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the Founder and Director of World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.

rows.source: "Mó ní ìrétí ayọ lórí sáà tó ń bọ̀ yìí lórí wẹ́ẹ̀bù,” Bermers-Lee ṣàfikún ọ̀rọ̀.
rows.output: "I am hopeful about the future of the web," he added.
rows.reference: "I'm incredibly optimistic for this next era of the web," Berners-Lee added.

rows.source: Bernard Vann: Àlùfàá Victoria Cross ti WW1 ní wọ́n ṣayẹyẹ rẹ̀ ṣayẹyẹ rẹ̀
rows.output: Bernard Vann: The WW1 Victoria Cross recipient was honored by the British Army.
rows.reference: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric celebrated

rows.source: Àlùfáà Sọ́ọ̀sì kannáà tí ó wà ní ilẹ̀ Gẹ́ẹ̀sí tó jẹ ẹ̀bún Victoria Cross lákòókò Ogun Àgbáyé Àkọ́kọ́ bí jagunjagun ni wọn ti ṣayẹyẹ rẹ̀ ní ilú abínibí rẹ́ lẹ́yín bí 100.
rows.output: The Rev. Canon Sọ́ọ̀sì, who was awarded the Victoria Cross during World War I, was honored in his home town after 100 years.
rows.reference: The only Church of England cleric to win a Victoria Cross during World War One as a combatant has been celebrated in his hometown 100 years on.

rows.source: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ náà ní oṣù kẹsàn án 1918 nínú ìkọlù ní Bellenglise àti Lehaucourt.
rows.output: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann received the award in September 1918 in the Battle of Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.
rows.reference: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann won the award on 29 September 1918 in the attack at Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.

rows.source: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, asọnipa kán ló pa á ní bí ọjọ̀ mẹ́rin lẹ́yìn náà tí kò sí mọ̀ pé ó ti jẹ ẹ̀bùn tó ga jùlọ nínú ọ́wọ̀ tó ga jùlọ nínú ilé iṣẹ́ ológun tí ilẹ̀ Gẹ́ẹ̀sì.
rows.output: However, he was only able to survive for four days after that, without knowing that he had received the greatest gift in the hands of the greatest military leader of the British Empire.
rows.reference: However, he was killed by a sniper four days later and never knew he had won the highest British military honour.

rows.source: Òkúta ìṣèrántí ní àwọn ọmọ rẹ̀ méjèèjì fi lọ́lẹ̀ ní ibi ìtólẹ́ṣẹ́ ẹ̀yẹ ní Rushden, Northamptonshire, ní Sátidé.
rows.output: The memorial stone was laid by her two sons at the Rushden Cemetery, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.
rows.reference: A commemorative stone was unveiled by his two grandsons at a parade in Rushden, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.

rows.source: Ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ọmọ ọmọ rẹ̀, Michael Vann, sọ pé ó jẹ́ “àmí tó fọ́gbọ́nyọ”, òkútà náà ní wọ́n máa filọ́lẹ̀ ní kété tí ọdún 100 tí bábá bàbà wọ́n gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ ìborí náà bá pé.
rows.output: One of his grandchildren, Michael Vann, said it was a "symbol of shame", the coffin was to be buried in a few years after the 100th anniversary of the awarding of the prize.
rows.reference: One of his grandsons, Michael Vann, said it was "brilliantly symbolic" the stone would be revealed exactly 100 years on from his grandfather's award-winning feat.

rows.source: Gẹ́gẹ́bí Gásẹ́ẹ̀tì London, ní 29 oṣù kẹsàn án 1918, Lt Col Van ló saájú ìkọ̀ àwọn ọmọ ogun ní ìkọjá Canal de Saint-Quentin “láàrin kurukuru tó nípọ̀n àti lábẹ́ ẹ iná ńlá ńla láti ara àwọn ìbọ́n ẹlẹ́rọ ńlá."
rows.output: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918, Lt Col Van led the advance of the troops across the Saint-Quentin Canal "between the thick fog and under a heavy fire from large artillery."
rows.reference: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."

rows.source: Ó wà ṣáré lọ sí ibi ìlà ìfàyàgbọta pẹ̀lú “Ìgbòyà tó ga jùlọ” tí ó sì siwájú ikọ̀ náà kí ó tó di wípé ó da ìbọn bolẹ̀ ní òun nìkan tí ó sì pà mẹ́tà nínú àwọn èni náà.
rows.output: He ran to the front of the line with "the highest confidence" and continued to advance the line until he dropped the gun and shot five of them.
rows.reference: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.

rows.source: Asọnipa Jamaní ló pa Lt Col Vann ní ọjọ 4 oṣù kẹwàá 1918 - ní bí oṣù kan kọjá díẹ̀ kí ogun tó parí.
rows.output: Lieutenant Colonel Vann was killed by German snipers on 4 February 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.
rows.reference: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.

rows.source: Michael Vann, 72, sọ pé àwọn ìgbéṣẹ̀ bàbà bàbà rẹ̀ jẹ́ “ohun tí mo ma tí ń kóm sì le dà láyé ṣùgbọ́n tí ó jẹ́ ohun ìrẹ̀lẹ.̀”
rows.output: Michael Vann, 72, said his father's actions were "something I could never have imagined in my life but it was a kind act."
rows.reference: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."

rows.source: Òun àti ẹ̀gbọ́n rẹ̀ Dr James Vann gbé àmì ẹ̀yẹ kalẹ̀ bakan náà lẹ́yìn ìtòlẹ́ṣẹ ẹlẹ́yẹ, èyí tí ẹgbẹ́ eléré ọba Brentwood darí.

rows.source: Michael Vann sọ pé “inú òun dùn láti kópa nínú ìtòlẹ́ṣẹ ẹlẹ́yẹ náà” tí ó sì tún sọ pé “Àtìlẹyìn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn ó ṣàfihàn ìgboyà ojúlówó akọni ńlá."
rows.output: Michael Vann said he was "honored to be a part of the elite team" and also said that "the support of many people shows the true courage of a great champion."

rows.source: Àwọn olólùfẹ́ MMA ní wọ́n sàìsùn láti wo Bellator 206, dípò èyí Peppa Pig ní wọ́n wò

rows.output: Mickelson led with 18 under par. Furyk, who was in the group behind him, said that being in the group behind him made him feel like he had a lot of pressure on him.
rows.reference: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.

rows.source: "Ó jẹ́ apanilẹ́rìn ín, ó jẹ́ aláwàdà, ó nífẹ́ láti máa ṣ’ẹ̀fẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn, àti pé ọkùnrin tí ó dára ni látin í nínú yàrá alájọṣepọ̀,” ó ṣàlàyé.
rows.output: He's a prankster, he's a joker, he loves to fool people, and a good man is in the bedroom.
rows.reference: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.

rows.source: "Mo rò pé àwọn àkópa tó kéré díẹ̀ gbádùn ara wọn pẹ̀lú rẹ̀, bakan náà, ní ọ̀ṣẹ̀ yìí, tí ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó dùn mọ́ni láti rí.
rows.output: I think a few of the guests enjoyed themselves with him, too, and in this one, which is something I always enjoy seeing.
rows.reference: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.

rows.source: Ó pèsè ọ̀pọ̀ ǹkan jú kíkopa nìkan lọ."
rows.output: He provided a lot more than just a role.
rows.reference: He provides a lot more than just play."

rows.source: Olórí yúròpù Thomas Bjorn mọ̀ pé ìléwájú tó pọ̀ má tó tán.
rows.output: European Tour leader Thomas Bjorn knows that the lead is not enough.
rows.reference: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn, olórí tí yúrópù, mọ̀ nípa ìrírí pé ìléwájú níwọ́nba tó súnmọ́ ọjọ̀ ìkẹhìn ẹlẹ́nìkan fún Ìfe ẹ̀yẹ Ryder le ṣàdédé yí padà sí ohun tí kò ní rọrùn.
rows.output: Thomas Bjorn, the European leader, knows from experience that the final day of the Ryder Cup can be a very difficult day to turn things around.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.

rows.source: The Dane fakọyọ ní ọdún 1997 ní Valderrama, níbití Seve Ballesteros ti ní àmì ayò márùn lórí akẹgbẹ́ wọn láti Amerika, ṣùgbọ́n ṣóńsó imú wọn ní wọ́n fí gbégbá orókè ní ìlà-ìparí tí wọ́n sì borí pẹ̀lú 14½-13½.
rows.output: The Dane won in 1997 at Valderrama, where Seve Ballesteros had a score of five points on his American opponent, but they were both disqualified in the final round and the match ended in a draw with 14½-13½.
rows.reference: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.

rows.source: “Kí ó máa rán ara rẹ létí pé a gbégbá orókè ní Valderrama; a gbìyànjú Brookline bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé a fìdí rẹmi, ṣùgbọ́n ní Valderrama a bórí gíníngínín. Bjorn, sọ pé nígbàtí òun wó ìdíje àwọn kíílàsì 2018 bí wọ́n ṣe borí pẹ̀lú 5-3 ní ọjọ́ Furaide àti ní àná bí wọ́n ṣe borí Le Golf National pẹ̀lú 10-6.
rows.output: "Remember that we were the favorites in Valderrama; we tried Brookline, but we were defeated, but we won in Valderrama. Bjorn said that when he was in the 2018 class, they were defeated with 5-3 on Friday and on Saturday they were defeated by Le Golf National with 10-6.
rows.reference: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.

rows.source: Fún ìdí èyí ìtàn máa ṣàfihàn fún mi àti ẹnikẹ́ni nínú alájọṣepọ̀ pe kò tíì tán síbẹ.
rows.output: This story will show me and anyone in a relationship that it's never too late.
rows.reference: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.

rows.source: Wàá lọ̀ bí ó ṣe yẹ jùlọ́ ní ọ̀la.
rows.output: Let's go as best as we can tomorrow.
rows.reference: You go full bore tomorrow.

rows.source: Jáde síta níbẹ̀yẹn kí o ṣe ohun tí ó yẹ
rows.output: Get out there and do what is right
rows.reference: Get out there and do all the right things.

rows.source: Eyi koiti Pati titi waa ni koko Lori boodu.
rows.output: This is not a party until the music starts.
rows.reference: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.

rows.source: A ní àfojúsùn, ìyẹn ni láti gbìyànjú láti gba ife ẹ̀yẹ yìí, àtipé ibẹ̀yẹn gan an ní àfojúsùn wà’.
rows.output: Our goal is, that is, to try to win this trophy, and there is a goal there.
rows.reference: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.

rows.source: Mo ti sọ mláti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, Mo gbájúmọ́ àwọn èléré ìdárayá 12 tí wọ́n wà lápá ọ̀dọ̀ wa, ṣùgbọ́n a mọ ohun tí ó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ dáadáa ní apá kejì wa -. àwọn eléré ìdárayá tó dára jùlọ ní àgbáyé”
rows.output: I have mentioned before, I focused on the 12 athletes around us, but we knew what was happening on the other side - "the best athletes in the world."
rows.reference: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."

rows.source: Pẹ̀lú bí inú rẹ̀ ṣe dùn lórí i bí àwọn elére ìdárayá rẹ̀ ṣe fakọyọ sí lórí pápá gọ́ọ̀fù, Bjorn ṣàláyè sí wípé: "Èmi kò ní síwájú ara mi lórí eléyìí.
rows.output: With how much joy he was on the golf course, Bjorn said: "I'm not going to be ahead of myself on this one.
rows.reference: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.

rows.source: Ohun to yàtọ̀ pátápátá ni ọ̀lá jẹ́.
rows.output: The most important thing is respect.
rows.reference: Tomorrow's a different beast.

rows.source: Ọ̀lá jẹ́ ìṣesí ẹ̀nì kọ̀ọ̀kan to ń farahàn, àtipé èyí jẹ́ ohun ti ó yàtọ̀ gedégbé láti ṣe.
rows.output: Pride is a personal attitude, and this is something that is very different from being humble.
rows.reference: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.

rows.source: Ohun tí ó dára ni láti wà pẹ̀lú enìkan nígbàtí àwọn n[kan bá ńlọ dáradára, ṣùgbọ́n, nígbàtí o ẹ̀nìkọ̀ọ̀kan bá dá wà, nigbànáa ní ìdánwò àdánán máa ṣẹ̀lẹ̀ sí ọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́bí eléré ìdárayá gọ́ọ̀fù.
rows.output: It's good to be with someone when they're doing well, but when you're on your own, you're more likely to get tested as a player in a golf game.
rows.reference: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.

rows.source: Ìyẹn ní ìfiránṣẹ́ tí o níláti fi ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn elérée ìdárayá, èyí ní láti mú ohun tó dára jùlọ jáde lára rẹ ní ọ̀la.
rows.output: That is the message you have to send to the athletes, this is to bring out the best in you in the future.
rows.reference: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.

rows.source: Nísìnyí, o fi ẹnìkejì rẹ sẹ́hìn ó sì níláti lọ mọ́ bí ó sẹ máa mu ohun tó dára jù jáde lát ara rẹ̀, bákan náà."
rows.output: Now, you put the second one behind and you have to find out how to get the best out of yourself, too."
rows.reference: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."

rows.source: Ní ìdàyàtọ̀ sí Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk tí ó jẹ́ nọ́ńbà ìdàkejì máa ma wá àwọn eléré ìdárayá rẹ̀ láti le ní ìṣesí tó dára ní ẹlẹ́nìkọ̀ọ̀kan ju bí wọ́n ṣe ṣe lọ ní aláṣepọ̀, àwọn tó dáyàtọ̀ Jordan Spieth àti Justin Thomas, tí wọ́n ní máàkì mẹ́ta nínú mẹ́rin
rows.output: In contrast to Bjorn, his opposite number Jim Furyk, who is also a number two player, would often bring his players to have a better individual performance than they did in the partnership, the contrasting Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who have three majors in four years.
rows.reference: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.

rows.source: Furyk funra ara rẹ ti wà ní apá méjèèjì ibi ti àwọn ọjọ́ tó kẹ́hìn ńlá ti ṣàdédé yípadà, lẹ́yìn tí ó ti jẹ́ ara àwọn alájọṣepọ̀tó tò borí ní kí ó tó parí rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́bí aláìláṣeyọrí ní Yúrópù mú kí “Ìyànu ńlá ní Mẹ̀dínà” ti ara rẹ̀ jáde.
rows.output: Furyk himself was on both sides of the great change that had come about in the last few years, after having been a partner in the great European failure that led to his "Mediterranean Nightmare."
rows.reference: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."

rows.source: “Mo ránti gbogbo gbolohun kọ̀ọ̀kan tó jẹ jáde nínú rẹ̀,” ó sọ̀rọ̀ ní ìfèsì sí ìbéèrè bí Ben Crenshaw, olórí ilé ní 1999, ṣe ṣàtòjọ̀ àwọn eléré ìdárayá rẹ̀ lásìkò ìgbà ìkẹ̀hìn náà.
rows.output: "I remember every word of it," he said in response to Ben Crenshaw's, the 1999 leader, listing of his players during the final session.
rows.reference: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.

rows.source: "A ní ìfigagbága 12 tó ṣe pàtàkì lóla, ṣùgbọ́n o máa fẹ́ láti tètè dé ibi ìyára bẹ̀rẹ̀ bí i ọ ṣe rí i ní Brookline, bí o ṣe rí i ní Medinah.
rows.output: "We have 12 important goals for the year, but you will want to get to the starting line as quickly as possible, as you did in Brookline, as you did in Medinah.
rows.reference: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.

rows.source: Nígbà abala kan bá ń lọ dáadáa, ó máa rán àwon ìfigagbaga ààrín lọ́wọ̀.
rows.output: At a certain point, it will send the middle runners away.
rows.reference: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.

rows.source: A ṣètò ìtọ̀ gbọorọ̀ wa lórí ìlà lọ́wọ̀ọ̀wọ́ tí a sí mú kí àwọn ẹni tiwa jẹ́ jádení ọ̀nà àrà ọ̀tọ̀ tí ó wù wá, o mọ̀, a ń gbìyànjú láti pidán lọla."
rows.output: We set our goals on a straight line and made sure that our people were on the right path, you know, we were trying to make a difference.
rows.reference: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."

rows.source: Thomas ní ó gba iṣẹ́ pàtàkì lórí dídarí ìjagbara àti kíkojú Rory Mcllroy nínú ìfigagbaga to le jù, Pẹ̀lú Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahim, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulte tThomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter tí wọ́n jẹ́ ara Yúrópù núnú ìdámejì ìtòléra láti òkè.
rows.output: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter all in the European half of the draw.
rows.reference: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.

rows.source: "Mo ti wà pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀wọ̀ àwọn ẹni wọ̀nyìí nínú ìtòléra yìí nítorípé mo rò pé ó kó àkóyáwọ́,” Bjorn ló sọ bẹ́ẹ̀ nípa àwọn àkopa ẹlẹ́nìkọ̀ọ̀an rẹ̀.
rows.output: "I've been with these people in this camp because I think it's a very important cause," Bjorn said of his fellow competitors.
rows.reference: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.

rows.source: Ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi tuntun ti Germany ti di sísún síwájú lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi
rows.output: The new German warship has again been launched
rows.reference: Germany's new warship postponed yet again

rows.source: Àkọ̀tun Ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi ti Jámáànù ní ó yẹ kí ó ti di fífi lọ́lẹ̀ ní ọdún 2014 láti pààrọ̀ àwọn ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi Sáà-ogún Dúkùú, ṣùgbọ́n kò ní rí bẹ́ẹ̀ títí di, ó kéré jù, ọdún í ó ń bọ̀ nítorí àwọn èròjà tó ti bàjẹ̀ àti àwọn ìnáwò tó ti ṣarajọ, ilé iṣẹ́ ìròyìn abẹ́léni ó jábọ̀ rẹ̀.
rows.output: The German Navy's Type 125 frigates were originally scheduled to be decommissioned in 2014 to be replaced by the Baden-Württemberg class, but this will not happen until at least the next year due to a lack of funding and a shortage of resources, the defense ministry announced.
rows.reference: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.

rows.source: Síṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ "Rheinland-Pfalz," olórí ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi tí ìsọ̀rí fírígéètì Baden-Wuerttemberg tuntun nini, ni ó ti di sísún ṣíwájú títi di ìdájì àkọ́kọ́ ọdún 2019, gẹ́gẹ́bi ìwé ìròyìn Die Zeit ṣe sọ tí ọgá ológun kan sọ.
rows.output: The launch of "Rheinland-Pfalz," the new flagship of the Baden-Wuerttemberg class of frigates, has been delayed until the first half of 2019, as reported by the newspaper Die Zeit, citing a military official.
rows.reference: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.

rows.source: Ó yẹ kí ọkọ̀ ojú omi nlá náà darapọ̀ ní 2014, ṣùgbọ̀n àwọn wàhálà ìṣòro lẹ́yìn ìfakalẹ̀ rẹ̀ ní ó mú kí ìgbẹ́kẹ́lé nínú itẹ̀síwájú àkànṣe iṣẹ́ náà já sófo.
rows.output: The shipyard was supposed to join the fleet in 2014, but the problems that followed its launch led to a loss of confidence in the project's progress.
rows.reference: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.

rows.source: Àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi ńlá mẹ́rin ti ìsọ̀rí Baden-Wuerttemberg tí Àwọn ọmọ ogún ojú omi sànwó fún ;áti 2007 máa wá gẹ́gẹ́bí arọ́pò sí ìṣọ̀rí àwọn fírígéétì Bremen.
rows.output: Four large patrol ships of the Baden-Wuerttemberg class, which were built for the German Navy, are to be delivered in 2007 as replacements for the Bremen class frigates.
rows.reference: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.

rows.source: Ó yé wá pé wọ́n máa ṣàfihàn Kanọ́ọ̀nù tó lágbara,ọ̀wọ́ àwọn mísáìlì aṣòdì-sí-bàálù àti aṣòdì-sí-ọkọ̀ orí omi àti àwọn ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ nǹka ìjagun mìíràn, bíi rédà, ínfúrárẹ́ẹ̀dì àti àwọn ìfọ́wọ́sí abáfẹfẹ́ṣiṣẹ́.
rows.output: They will also demonstrate the latest in cruise missiles, torpedoes, and other naval combat systems, such as radar, infrared, and air-launched missiles.
rows.reference: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.

rows.source: Àwọn ohun pàtàkì mìràn gẹ́gẹ́bí ìgbà ìṣàbójútó lóòrèkóòrè - p yẹ kó ṣeéṣe láti ṣàfillẹ̀ awọn fírígéètì fún bí ọdún méjì jìnnà sí ìbúdó \kọ ojú omi.
rows.output: Other important factors, such as the frequency of inspections - p should be possible to fill the refrigerators for about two years from the port of disembarkation.
rows.reference: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.

rows.source: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, ìdádúró gbogbo ìgbà túmọ̀ sí wípé àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi ìṣaajú - tí wọn sọ pé ó jẹ́ kí ilẹ̀ jámánì ní agbara ní òkè òkun - ti máa di èyí tí kò bá ìgbà mu mọ́ ní àkókò tí wọ́n bá wọ iṣẹ́. Die Zelt ló pe àkíyèsí yìí.
rows.output: However, the continuous stoppage meant that the fast patrol vessels - which were said to give Germany control of the seas - would only be effective when they were in service. The Zelt referred to this observation.
rows.reference: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.

rows.source: Fírígèètì F125 tí ó kùnà náà gba gogbo ìròyìn kan ní ọdún tó kọjá, nígbàtí Àwọn ọmọ ogun ojú omi kọ̀ jàlẹ̀ láti ṣafilọlẹ̀ ọkọ̀ ojú omi ńlá náà tí wọ́n sì dá a padà sí ìlé iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀ ojú omi Blohm & Voss ní Hamburb.
rows.output: The failed F125 frigate project was a major embarrassment for the Navy, which had to scramble to keep the program alive. The Navy's top brass had been so enamored with the ship that they had ignored warnings from the ship's builder, Blohm & Voss, that the vessel was not seaworthy.
rows.reference: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.

rows.source: Èyí jẹ ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ tí Àwọn ọ́mọ ogun ojú omi máa dá ọkọ̀ ojú omi padà fún ilé iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀ ojú omi ṣiṣe lẹ́yìn tí wọn ti fà á kalẹ̀.
rows.output: This is the first time that the Navy will return a ship to the shipyard for repair after it was sunk.
rows.reference: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.

rows.source: Díẹ̀ ní a mọ̀ nípa ìdí tí ọkọ̀ ojú omi náà fi di dídá padà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn oníwè ìròyìn jámànù sọ díẹ nípa “àṣìṣe sọ́fútìwíà àti hádìwíà” tí ó mú kí ọkọ̀ ìfijagun ojú omi náà má wúlò tí ó bá di lílò ní ojú ogun.
rows.output: Some details are known about why the ship was sent back, but the news reports mention "technical and mechanical errors" that made the warship unsuitable for use if it was to be deployed in combat.
rows.reference: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.

rows.source: Àìpé sọ́fùtiwìà jẹ́ ohún tí ó ṣe pàtàkì gan nítorí awọn 120 awakọ̀ ojú omi ni wọ́n máa wa ìsọ̀rí ọkọ̀ ojú omi ńlá Baden-Wuerttemberg-class náà - èyí tí ó jẹ́ ìdájí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ nínú àwọn fírígéètì ìsọ̀rí Bremen àtijọ́.
rows.output: The absence of a ferry is a serious problem because there are 120 ferry drivers who will be unemployed - this is a loss of jobs for 120 employees in the Bremen shipyard.
rows.reference: Software deficiencies were particularly important as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels will be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - just half of the manpower on older Bremen class frigates.

rows.source: Olujẹjọ, Khalid Barnes, ni a fi ẹsun pipa awọn onta egbogi oloro meji sugbon o gba ẹjọ ẹwọn gbere ni September 2009.
rows.output: Prosecutor, Khalid Barnes, was charged with the murder of two drug dealers but was acquitted in September 2009.

rows.source: Ni igba ikẹhin ti a funni ni idajọ iku nni ẹjọ Gbogboogbo New York ni 1953 fun Julius ati Ethel Rosenberg, tọkọtaya kan ti a pa lẹhin ti wọn ti fi ẹsun iyọkẹlẹ wolu fun Soviet Union nigba ogun buburu ni ọdun meji ṣaaju.
rows.output: In the last year of capital punishment in the United States, the death sentence was handed down in 1953 in the case of Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple who were executed after being convicted of espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years earlier.
rows.reference: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.

rows.source: Awọn Rosenbergs mejeeji ni wọn pa nipasẹ ijoko mọnamọna ni June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Both Rosenbergs were executed by electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.reference: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.

rows.output: We want to make our own laws in our country.

rows.output: In a message to Ms. May, she added: 'Ministerial representatives are covering up their work when they do not fulfill their promises.'

rows.output: Mr. Farage told the audience that politicians must "feel the heat" if they want to change the decision made in the 2016 referendum.

rows.source: Ní ọjọ́ Sátidé, àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue, La., kéde àtìmọ́lé olùfurasí tó yìnbọn pa Wayde Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU, ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀.
rows.output: On Saturday, the Baton Rouge, La., police announced the arrest of a suspect in the shooting death of Wayde Sims, a former member of the LSU football team.
rows.reference: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.

rows.source: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue kéde àtìmọ́lé Dyteon Simpson, ọmọ ogún ọdún (20) ní aago mọkànlá òwúrọ̀ lásìkò.
rows.output: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, a 20-year-old man, at 11:30 a.m.
rows.reference: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, 20, at an 11 a.m. ET news conference.

rows.source: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣe àfihàn fídíò ìbọn yínyìn ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Wọ́n ní ẹni tó bá dá ẹni tó yìnbọn náà mọ̀, kó sọ fún àwọn.
rows.output: The police released a video of the shooting on Friday. They identified the shooter but did not disclose his name.
rows.reference: They had released a video of the shooting on Friday, asking for help identifying a man seen in the footage.

rows.source: Ní kùtùkùtù ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, nítọ̀sí Southern University, ni ọta ìbọn ba Sims, ọmọ ogun (20) ọdún, tó sì kú.
rows.output: On Saturday, at Southern University, a bullet shot by a soldier (20 years old) killed Sims, a student.
rows.reference: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.

rows.source: Ọ̀gá ọlọ́pàá, Murphy J. Paul sọ fún ilé-ìròyìn 247sports pe “Ọgbẹ́ orí látàrí ọta ìbọn tó ba Wayde Sims ló pa á.”
rows.output: Superior Police Commissioner, Murphy J. Paul, told 247Sports that "The bullet that killed Wayde Sims was not from the gun that was fired by the police."
rows.reference: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.

rows.source: Wayde ń gbèjà ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀ ni kí Simpson tó yìnbọn fun un.
rows.output: Wayde was defending his friend when Simpson shot him.
rows.reference: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.

rows.source: Nínú ìdáhùn ẹ, Simpson jẹ́wọ́ pé òun wà ní ibi iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, òun ní ìbọn lọ́wọ́, àti pé òun ló yìnbọn fún Wayde Sims.
rows.output: In the aftermath, Simpson admitted that he was at the scene, he was the shooter, and he had shot Wayde Sims.

rows.output: Simpson was arrested by the police in East Baton Rouge Parish.

rows.source: Sims, ọmọ tó ga fíofío, ṣe kékeré ẹ̀ ní Baton Rogue. Ní sáà tó kọjá, ó gbá bọ́ọ̀lu-aláfọwọ́gbá fún ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ ní ìgbà méjìlélọ́gbọ̀n (32). Ó bá wọn bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ẹ̀mẹwàá nínú ẹ̀.
rows.output: Sims, a 6-foot-10 forward, played for the Baton Rouge Bombers. In the last season, he averaged 32 points per game. He started the season in the tenth week.

rows.reference: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.

rows.source: “Kun tuna amsarta?

rows.output: What are you doing?

rows.source: A’a, uh, a’a, na jira ɗaya ne - wannan mummunan abu ne na alamar rashin gaskiya - mafi munin alamar rashin gaskiya da ban taɓa gani ba.”
rows.output: No, uh, no, I'm waiting for one - this is a bad thing of a lack of transparency - the worst thing of a lack of transparency that I've ever seen.
rows.reference: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."

rows.source: Yanzu Labour ba wani babban majami’a ne ba.
rows.output: Now Labour is no longer a major party.
rows.reference: Labour is no longer a broad church.

rows.source: Wani rashin haƙuri ne na waɗanda ke faɗan abin da ke cikin zuciyarsu
rows.output: It is a lack of tolerance for those who speak out what is in their hearts.
rows.reference: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds

rows.source: A lokacin da ‘yan rajin Momentum a cikin jam’iyyata ta gida suka jefa kuri’a don tsaida ni, ba wani abin mamaki ne ba.
rows.output: When the Momentum faction members in my home party voted to oust me, it was not surprising.
rows.reference: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.

rows.source: Tun da yake, ni ne mafi sabo a wani layi na mambobin Labour na majalisa da za a faɗa musu ba a maraba da mu - dukka saboda faɗan abi da ke zuciyarmu.
rows.output: In fact, I am the most recent in a line of Labour MPs who have been told that we are not welcome - all because of the things we say that are at the core of our beliefs.
rows.reference: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.

rows.source: Abokiyata a majalisa Joan Ryan ta sami irin wulakanci saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka tana faɗa da ra’ayin ƙin Yahudawa.
rows.output: My colleague in the House of Commons, Joan Ryan, has faced a lot of abuse because she has been steadfast in her opposition to the anti-Semitism.
rows.reference: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.

rows.source: A nawa misalin, batun dakatarwar ya soke ni don ƙin yarda da Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: For example, the issue of the suspension was canceled for me because I refused to accept Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: A kan amfani na wani ƙudurin tattalin arzikin mai kyau, a kan tsaron ƙasa, a kan Turai, abin takaici batutuwa iri guda wanda a kai Jeremy ya ƙi yarda da shugabanni da suka wuce.
rows.output: On the use of a sound economic policy, on national security, on Europe, the same issues that Jeremy refused to accept from previous leaders.
rows.reference: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.

rows.source: Sanarwa don taron Labour ta Nottingham ta Gabas a ranar Juma’a ta kawo cewa, “muna son tarukan su zama a haɗe da  ma’ana.”
rows.output: The Labour Party's Nottingham East constituency meeting on Friday was told, "we want the meetings to be inclusive and meaningful."
rows.reference: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."

rows.source: Ga mafi yawan na shekaru takwas ɗin a matsayi na mamban Labour a majalisa, haka dai yake daren tarukan GC.
rows.output: For most of the past eight years, I have been a member of the Labour Party in Parliament, just as it is on the night of the GC meetings.
rows.reference: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.

rows.source: Abin takaici a yau, ba shi ne fasalin taruka da yawa kuma alkawari na siyasa ta “ihsani, hankali” tuni aka manta idan, ma, an taɓa farawa.
rows.output: It is a pity today that it is not a feature of many conventions and the political promise of "ihsani, hankali" has already been forgotten if, indeed, it was ever initiated.
rows.reference: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.

rows.source: Yana ƙara zama a bayyane fili cewa ba a haƙuri da ra’ayoyi daban-daban a cikin jam’iyyar Labour kuma ana hukunta kowane ra’ayi a kan ko zai karɓu ga shugabannin jam’iyyar.
rows.output: It is becoming increasingly clear that there is no tolerance for different views within the Labour Party and any view that is not accepted by the party leaders is being punished.
rows.reference: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.

rows.source: Wannan ya fara jim kaɗan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, don abokan aiki da nake jin a da muna da irin mahangar siyasa sun fara tsammani zan yi wani juyi da daukan matsaya da ba zan taɓa yarda da su ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwa guda ta Tarayyar Turai.
rows.output: This started a few months after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues who I used to have a similar political outlook with began to expect that I would take a stance on issues such as national security or the single market of the European Union that I would never agree with.
rows.reference: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.

rows.source: A kodayaushe na yi magana a cikin jama’a - kuma ba ruwan haƙiƙa abin da na ce - kawai sai tarun cin mutunci a kan kafar sadar zumunta ana kira ga sake zaɓe, ana watsi da siyasar ta tsakiya, ana faɗa mun cewa ya kamata na zama ba na cikin jam’iyyar Labour.
rows.output: I have always spoken out in public - and not always in a truthful manner - and the mob on social media is called to demand a re-election, the politics of the center are dismissed, and it is said that I should not be a member of the Labour Party.
rows.reference: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.

rows.source: Kuma wannan ba kawai abin da na gani ne ba.
rows.output: And this is not the only thing I have seen.
rows.reference: And that is not just my experience.

rows.source: Haƙiƙa, na san na ti sa’a sosai fiye da sauran abokan aikina saboda umarce-umarce da ake fuskantowa a kaina sukan zama na siyasa.
rows.output: Of course, I know I've been much more fortunate than my colleagues because the challenges I face are often political in nature.
rows.reference: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.

rows.source: Ina cikin dan shayi na ra’ayin kwarewa da ƙudurtawa ta waɗannan abokan aikin waɗanda ke fuskantar wani cin mutunci ta fuska jinsi ko bambancin launin fata a kowace rana amma ba su taɓa gudu ba.
rows.output: I am in a tea shop, and I am experiencing a sense of camaraderie with these colleagues who are facing discrimination based on gender or race every day, but they never give up.
rows.reference: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.

rows.source: Daya daga cikin ɓangarorin abu mafi ɓata rai a wannan lokaci na siyasa shi ne yadda lebur-lebur na cin mutunci suna zama ruwan dare.
rows.output: One of the most depressing aspects of this period of politics is the way that the smear campaigns have become the norm.
rows.reference: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn ya ce a mako da ya wuce cewa ya kamata jam’iyyar Labour ta samar da wata al’adar haƙuri.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn said last week that the Labour Party should have a culture of tolerance.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.

rows.source: Abin da yake zahiri shi ne yanzu mu ba wancan babbar majami’ar ne ba da kowane batu na “ba a yarda da iyawa ba” ko canjin dokokin zaɓe a ce jam’iyya tana zama karama.
rows.output: What is actually happening is that we are now no longer the big church on the issue of "no limits" or the change in election laws to say that the party is becoming small.
rows.reference: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.

rows.source: Na sha samun sharawa da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka wuce ana kira da na yi shiru, kar na yi surutu shi ke nan zan zama “ba wata matsala.”
rows.output: I have received many invitations in the past two years to be silent, to not make noise, that I will be "no problem."
rows.reference: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."

rows.source: Amma ban shiga siyasa don na yi wannan abu ba.
rows.output: But I didn't get into politics because of this.
rows.reference: But that is not what I came into politics to do.

rows.source: Tun da ma na shiga jam’iyyar Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin wani yaro dan makaranta, da ya sami zaburarwa daga wazarai na gwamnatin Thatcher da a fakaice ta bar cikekken ajina na makaranta yana faɗuwa, na yi tunanin na zama gwarzon gyara ayyukan jama’a ga waɗanda ke buƙatar sosai - ko a matsayi na wani kansila na gida ko ministan gwamnati.
rows.output: Since I joined the Labour Party 32 years ago as a schoolboy, I was inspired by the welfare state created by the Thatcher government, which in reality left a gaping hole in the school budget, I thought I was destined to be a champion of public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or a government minister.
rows.reference: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.

rows.source: Ban taɓa boye siyasata ba, har da cikin zaɓen da ya gabata.
rows.output: I have never hidden my politics, not even in the last election.
rows.reference: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.

rows.source: Ba wani daga cikin Nottingham ta Gabas da za a ce ya shiga ruɗani game da matsayin ƙudurina da yankuna na rashin amincewa tare da shugabancin yanzu.
rows.output: None of the Eastern Nottinghamshire MPs have any idea about the position of my resolution and the areas of non-confidence with the current leadership.
rows.reference: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.

rows.source: Ga waɗanda suka tallata batu na ranar Juma’a, abin da dukka zan ce shi ne cewa a lokacin da ƙasar ke tattaki zuwa wani Brexit da zai cutar da iyalai, kasuwanci da ayyukan gwamnati, ban fahimci sha’awar ɓata lokaci da ƙarfin gwiwa ba a kan mubaya’a ta zuwa ga shugaban jam’iyyar Labour.
rows.output: To those who promoted the issue on Friday, all I would say is that at a time when the country is heading for a Brexit that will harm families, businesses and public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on a mission to the leader of the Labour Party.
rows.reference: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.

rows.source: Amma a zahiri kuwa saƙo ɗaya da nake da shi ba zuwa ga Nottingham Momentum ne ba, zuwa ga mazaɓata ne, ko mambobin Labour ko a’a: Ina alfahari da yin aiki don jama’a kuma na yi alkawari cewa ba wani irin barazana sake zaɓe ko ruɗanin siyasa da zai hana ni yin aiki a cikin abin da na yi imani da shi shi ne mafi kyawun abubuwan da za su yi wa jama’a dadi gaba ɗaya.
rows.output: But in reality, the message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, but to the wards, or to Labour members or not: I am proud to work for the public and I have pledged that no form of intimidation or political manipulation will stop me from working in what I believe is the best thing for the public good.
rows.reference: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.
