rows.output: Chris Leslie is a member of the East Nottingham constituency
rows.reference: Chris Leslie is MP for Nottingham East

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr da ba a doke ba ta yi sama
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr remained unbeaten at the top
rows.reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top

rows.source: Gwaje-gwaje guda biyu masu jinkiri sun tsallake sakamakon ƙarshe wani iri, amma babu shakka Ayr ya dace ya ci nasara a cikin wannan nishaɗi mai ban mamaki na wasan Premiership na Tennent na ranar.
rows.output: Two slow-motion tests were missed by the final result, but there was no doubt Ayr was worthy of winning this entertaining Premiership game of Tennent's on the day.
rows.reference: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.

rows.source: Su ne yanzu ke saman teburin, ɓangare da kaɗai ba a doke ba na goman.
rows.output: They are now at the top of the table, the only part of the ten that has not been defeated.
rows.reference: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.

rows.source: Daga ƙarshe, tsaronsu da ya fi girma ne, kamar ma samun damarsu ta yin magana sosai, wanda ta ɗauki gefen gidan kuma mai horar da ‘yan wasa Peter Murchie yana dukkan dalili da zai ji daɗi.
rows.output: Finally, their greatest security was their ability to speak freely, which took the edge off the house and the coach Peter Murchie's every reason to be happy.
rows.reference: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.

rows.source: “An gwada mu a cikin wasanninmu har zuwa nan, kuma har yanzu ba a doke mu ba, don haka dole na yi murna,” inji shi.
rows.output: "We have been tested in our matches up to now, and we have not yet been defeated, so I must be proud," he said.
rows.reference: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.

rows.source: Robyn Christie na Melrose ya ce: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ayr, sun ɗauki damammakinsu sosai fiye da yadda muka yi.”
rows.output: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Praise is assured for Ayr, they took their chances much better than we did."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."

rows.source: Gwajin mintina na 14 na gudunmawar Anderson, da  Frazier Climo ya sauya, sa Ayr a gaba, amma, wani rawayar kati don kyaftin na Scotland Rory Hughes, da Warriors suka sake don wasan, ya bari Melrose ta yi lambobin faɗa da Jason Baggot
rows.output: The 14-minute test of Anderson's contribution, with Frazier Climo's substitution, put Ayr ahead, but, a penalty for captain Scotland Rory Hughes, and the Warriors again for the game, left Melrose to score the equalizer with Jason Baggot.
rows.reference: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.

rows.source: Climo ya faɗaɗa shugabancin Ayr tare da wani fenalti, kafin, lokacin hutun rabin lokaci, ya ci shi ke nan ya musanya wani gwajin kai kaɗai don ya sa ya zama 17 zuwa 5 zuwa Ayr a hutun.
rows.output: Climo extended Ayr's lead with a penalty, before, during the half-time break, he scored again to make it 17-5 to Ayr in the break.
rows.reference: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.

rows.source: Amma Melrose ta fara rabi na biyun ne daidai kuma Patrick Anderson ya yi kokari, da Baggot ya musanya, rage hanyar wucewar zuwa matakai biyar.
rows.output: But Melrose started the second half exactly on time, and Patrick Anderson tried, with Baggot, to reduce the passing route to five steps.
rows.reference: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.

rows.source: A da akwai a lokacin wani jinkiri mai tsayi don wani rauni mai yawa ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka ɗauka a kan makara, kuma sake farawar, Ayr ta tura gaba dan saman ta hanyar wani gwaji na Stafford McDowall, da Climo ya musanya.
rows.output: There was also a long delay for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was carried off on a stretcher, and restarted, Ayr pushed ahead through a test of Stafford McDowall, with Climo substituted.
rows.reference: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.

rows.source: Sa’an nan an ba wa muƙaddashin kyaftin ɗin Ayr Blair Macpherson kati rawaya, haka kuma, Melrose ya sa mutumin ya ƙara biya wani gwajin Bruce Colvine da ba a musanya ba, daga ƙarshe wani mummuna harin matsi.
rows.output: Then the captain of the Ayrshire division, Blair Macpherson, was given a yellow card, as was Melrose, who was also ordered to pay a fine of £ 50 for a non-replaceable test by Bruce Colvine, ultimately a very expensive penalty.
rows.reference: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.

rows.source: Ɓangaren gidan ya dawo, amma, kuma a lokacin da aka ba da kati rawaya a Struan Hutchinson don tunkarar Climo ba tare da ƙwallo ba, daga layin wajen fenalti the penalty, MacPherson ya taɓa ƙasa daga bayan tunkuɗewar Ayr da ke kusantowa.
rows.output: The home side came back, but, and when a yellow card was given to Struan Hutchinson for a foul on Climo, from the penalty line, MacPherson touched the ball from behind the Ayr striker.
rows.reference: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.

rows.source: Climo ya musanyu, kamar yadda ya sake yi aƙalla daga farawa, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tara bugun akwati na David Armstrong kuma ya aika Gregor Henry wani waje don gwajin gefen gida na biyar.
rows.output: Climo conceded, as he had at least once before from the start, after Kyle Rowe had collected a corner kick from David Armstrong and sent Gregor Henry off for a fifth-minute home test.
rows.reference: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.

rows.source: Har yanzu tauraro Game ya shirya don sabon aiki a masana’antar sayar da abinci
rows.output: The Game star is preparing for a new role in the food industry.
rows.reference: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry

rows.source: Har yanzu tauraro Game Ford Kieran ya nuna ya shirya shiga zuwa cikin masana’antar kulawa bayan an gano an ba shi matsayi na daraktan wani kamfani mai lasisin sayar da abinci.
rows.output: The star of Ford Kieran's Game of Thrones, Kieran, has shown that he is ready to enter the food industry after being appointed director of a company with a license to sell food.
rows.reference: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.

rows.source: Mai shekaru 56 yana fitowa a Jack Jarvis a cikin sanannen shirin BBC, wanda yake rubutawa da sauran taurari tare da mai haɗn gwiwa dan barkwanci Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: A 56-year-old man is appearing as Jack Jarvis in the popular BBC series, which is written by and stars other actors along with co-writer and comedian Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: Su biyun sun sanar da cewa jerin nau’uka na tara da ke zuwa za su zama na ƙarshe a cikin gudanar da shirin, kuma ya bayyana Kiernan yana shirya rayuwa bayana Craiglang.
rows.output: They both announced that the upcoming season of nine would be the last in the program's run, and it was revealed that Kiernan was preparing to move on from Craiglang.
rows.reference: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.

rows.source: A cewar rubutaccen labari na jere-jere na kamfani, shi ne darakta na Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: According to the company's annual report, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: Ɗan wasan kwaikwayon ya ki yin ya ce wani kome a kan labarin, kodayake wata kafar labari ta Scottish Sun ta tsegunta cewa Kiernan yana neman ya shiga cikin “kasuwar sayar da abinci mai ci gaba” ta Glasgow.
rows.output: The actor refused to comment on the story, although a Scottish Sun report suggested that Kiernan was looking to join the "cutting-edge food market" of Glasgow.
rows.reference: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."

rows.source: ‘Tekun namu ne’: Bolivia da ke rufe da ƙasa tana fatan kotu za ta buɗe hanyar zuwa Pacific
rows.output: "Our sea is ours": Bolivia, landlocked and longing, hopes court will open a path to the Pacific
rows.reference: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific

rows.source: Matuƙan jirgin ruwa suna sintiri a wurin tsayuwa na hedikwatar sojojin ruwa a cikin La Paz.
rows.output: The naval patrol boats are stationed at the dock of the naval base in La Paz.
rows.reference: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.

rows.source: Gine-ginen gwamnati sun daga tutar launin teku shudi.
rows.output: Government buildings have a blue flag.
rows.reference: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.

rows.source: Sansanonin sojojin ruwa daga Tabkin Titicaca zuwa  Amazon da aka sa wa motto: “Teku namu ne a haƙƙi.
rows.output: Naval camps from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon were given the motto: "Our Sea is Our Life."
rows.reference: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.

rows.source: Dawo da shi haƙƙinmu ne.”
rows.output: It is our duty to return it to its rightful owners."
rows.reference: To recover it is a duty."

rows.source: A cikin gaba ɗaya Bolivia da ke kewaye da ƙasa, tuna rasa wani yankin bakin teku ga Chile wani mummunan rikicin albarkar abu na ƙarni na 19 har yanzu a fili a yake - don saboda shi ne buƙatar su sake bi ta ruwan Tekun Pacific Ocean.
rows.output: In the broader context of Bolivia, the loss of a coastal territory to Chile was a bitter pill to swallow, a painful reminder of a 19th-century territorial dispute that still lingers today - because it was a demand to regain access to the Pacific Ocean.
rows.reference: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.

rows.source: Waɗannan ire-iren fata suna watakila mafi girma a cikin shekaru, a lokacin da Bolivia din ke jiran wani ƙaramin hukunci daga kotun duniya a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar ana jin bahasi.
rows.output: These types of fat are perhaps the most significant in the past five years, as Bolivia waits for a small ruling from the World Court on October 1 after five years of hearing the case.
rows.reference: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.

rows.source: "Bolivia tana da kuzari, da halin haɗin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana tsammanin wani kyakkyawan batu da zai fito,” inji Roberto Calzadilla, wani jami’in diflomasiyya na Bolivia.
rows.output: "Bolivia is full of energy, with a sense of unity and stability, and it is undoubtedly looking forward to a very positive issue to emerge," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.reference: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.

rows.source: ‘Yan Bolivia za su kalli hukuncin na Kotun Duniyar a kan manyan talabijoji a faɗin ƙasar, suna masu fatan cewa kotun ta The Hague za ta sami matsaya na yarda da neman na Bolivia - bayan shekaru masu yawa na tattaunawa da ba nasara - Chile ta yarda da tattaunawa inda ta ba wa Bolivia ‘yancin mafita zuwa ga tekun.
rows.output: Bolivia's citizens will watch the ruling of the International Court of Justice on the maritime dispute with Chile on major television channels across the country, hoping that the court in The Hague will rule in favor of Bolivia's demands - after years of unsuccessful negotiations - Chile has agreed to negotiations where it has given Bolivia the right to a solution to the maritime dispute.
rows.reference: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.

rows.output: A map of the school, with interaction symbols, then encourages participants to think about what they do every day.

rows.output: But we believe they have the right to know - just as you have the right to know the risks to your health of smoking,' Professor Czeisler added.

rows.output: The tradition of keeping the mouth open in 'all-nighters' is still prevalent, he says, adding that modern technology and the pressure on students mean that sleep deprivation is becoming a major problem.
rows.reference: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.

rows.output: It should be a guarantee of getting enough sleep, a good sleep, to be a student's 'secret weapon' to ward off depression, fatigue, and irritability, as it - or to avoid obesity, as sleep deprivation often leaves the brain in a state of malnutrition, making it always hungry.

rows.output: Raymond So, a 19-year-old California student majoring in chemistry and biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course after taking one of his lectures during his first year at Harvard.

rows.source: Ya ce kwas ɗin ya buɗe masa idanuwansa da jan hankali don tura samun kwas ɗin a faɗin makarantar.
rows.output: He said the course opened his eyes and sharpened his mind to push for the course in the school.

rows.output: He hopes that the next step, will ask all students of the postgraduate section after graduation to complete a preparatory program for admission to a competitive university.

rows.source: Farfesa Czeisler  ya ba shawarar cewa ya kamata ɗalibai su kula da saita wata faɗakarwa ta lokacin da za su kwanta barci, har ma da lokacin da za su farka, da kuma sanin illolin cutarwa na ‘shuɗin haske’ da ke fitowa daga fuskokin kayayyakin lantarki da haske na LED, wanda zai iya jefa tsarin lafiyarku ta tashi a barci a cikin wani yanayi, wanda zai kai ga matsalolin kasa barci.
rows.output: Professor Czeisler suggested that students should take care to set an alarm for the time they go to bed, as well as for the time they wake up, and be aware of the negative effects of 'blue light' emitted from electronic devices and LED lights, which can throw off your sleep-wake cycle and lead to sleep disorders.
rows.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

rows.source: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard
rows.output: Livingston 1, Rangers 0: Menga's goal silences the crowd of Gerrard
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

rows.source: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers were punished in the 16th minute when Dolly Menga's header was deflected into the net from Steven Gerrard's pass to give Livingston a 1-0 lead.
rows.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

rows.source: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.
rows.output: The Ibrox side are looking to secure their first win on the road since their 4-1 victory at St Johnstone in March, but Gary Holt's side have only lost twice in 18 games under their new manager, who has left his side eight points adrift of the Ladbrokes Premiership leaders.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.
rows.output: The men were attacked seven minutes before half-time and a short corner by Rangers was held by the goalkeeper, who had never been as good as making a save.
rows.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

rows.source: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.
rows.output: While Rangers are now down to sixth place, Livingston has climbed up to third place and are only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

rows.source: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.
rows.output: And there could be further unrest stored for Rangers after the only observer Calum Spence was treated for a leg injury after it was clear that something had been thrown from the end of the ground.
rows.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas zuwa ga ɓangaren wanda ya jefa Ayr cikin wasannin kafin ƙarshe na Kofin Betfred.
rows.output: Gerrard made eight changes to the side that had been promoted by Ayr in the league matches before the Betfred Cup final.
rows.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

rows.source: Holt, a wani ɓangaren, ya tafi tare da irin Livi 11 ɗin wanda ta cire ɗigo daga Hearts mako da wuce kuma da ya yi murna da irin yadda waɗanda ya horar suka wahalar da masu adawarsu a kowane juyin da aka yi.
rows.output: Holt, on the other hand, was part of the Livi 11 group that removed the plaster from Hearts a week ago and was delighted with the way his former trainees had made life difficult for their opponents in every turn they took.
rows.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

rows.source: Za a kila ce Rangers sun mamaye kame ƙwallon amma Livingston sun yi abubuwa da yawa da ƙwallon da suka samu.
rows.output: The Rangers may have dominated the ball possession, but Livingston made a lot with the ball they had.
rows.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

rows.source: Ya kamata a ce sun ci kawai a mintina biyu na farawa lokacin musayar Menga ta farko da ta aika Scott Pittman ta cikin cin Allan McGregor amma mai tsaron tsakiya ya faɗaɗa damarsa babba sosai.
rows.output: They should have won only in the first two minutes of the first half when Menga's first exchange sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor, but the goalkeeper stretched to make a big save.
rows.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

rows.source: Wani dukan da ba tarewa na Keaghan Jacobs sai ya sami gola Craig Halkett amma abokinsa mai tsaro Alan Lithgow ya iya kawai faɗaɗawa ne a bayan matsayar.
rows.output: Keaghan Jacobs' free kick was met by Craig Halkett, but his teammate, goalkeeper Alan Lithgow, could only parry it away.
rows.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

rows.source: Rangers ta dai kama sarrafa amma akwai alamar ƙarin fata maimakon yarda game da wasansu a ukun ƙarshe.
rows.output: Rangers were in control, but there was a sign of further hope rather than acceptance of their position in the top three.
rows.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos ba shakka ya ji ya kamata a ce ya sami wani bugu daga kai sai gola a makin kashi na uku na rabin sa’a kamar yadda shi da Steven Lawless suka yi karo amma alƙalin wasa Steven Thomson ya manta koke-koke na Colombia.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos was clearly disappointed to be denied a penalty in the 33rd minute when he was brought down by Steven Lawless, but referee Steven Thomson ignored the Colombian's appeals.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

rows.source: Rangers ta yi ƙoƙarin kawai buge-buge na rabin farko na biyu a kan abin hari amma tsohon golan Ibrox Liam Kelly bai nuna wata damuwa ba daga bugun kai na Lassana Coulibaly da kuma wani harin sauri na Ovie Ejaria.
rows.output: Rangers tried to just get the ball in the first half of the second half on the target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly showed no concern from Lassana Coulibaly's header and a quick shot from Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

rows.source: Yayin da buɗin da Livi ta samu na mintina 34 kila ya zama a kan sake wasa, ba wanda zai iya ƙi sun cancance shi don cinsu da kawai suka samu.
rows.output: While Livi's 34-minute opening may have been a bit too long for a re-run, no one could deny that they deserved it just for the fact that they had only just received it.
rows.reference: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.

rows.source: Rangers sun sake kasa magance wani hoɓɓasa da Jacobs ya yi.
rows.output: Rangers were unable to address another Jacobs' blunder.
rows.reference: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.

rows.source: Scott Arfield bai yi martani ba inda Declan Gallagher ya sa ƙwallon zuwa ga Scott Robinson, wanda ya yi sanyi ga ɗaukan Menga na ɗan ƙaramin gamawa.
rows.output: Scott Arfield did not react where Declan Gallagher headed the ball to Scott Robinson, who took the Menga corner kick with a small touch.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi aiki a hutun inda ya sauya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent kuma sauyi ya kusan samar da wani tasirin nan da nan a matsayin mai kai hari ta kusurwa na sakun da ka yi wa Morelos amma mai ban sha’awa Kelly ya yi gudu daga layinsa don ya toshe.
rows.output: Gerrard worked the bench where he brought on Coulibaly and Ryan Kent and the substitution almost had an immediate impact as a corner kick was delivered to Morelos but the interesting Kelly ran offside to block it.
rows.reference: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.

rows.source: Amma Livingston ya ci gaba da soka maziyartan zuwa irin ainihin wasan da suke morewa, tare daLithgow da Halkett suna samun doguwar ƙwallo a sama a bayan doguwar ƙwallo.
rows.output: But Livingston continued to prod the audience into a more genuine appreciation of the game, with Lithgow and Halkett receiving a long ovation after a long shot.
rows.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

rows.source: Ɓangaren Holt da sun faɗaɗa matsayinsu na gaba a cikin matakan ƙarshe amma McGregor ya tsaya sosai ya hana Jacobs kafin Lithgow ya yi bugun ka daga kwanar.
rows.output: The Holt section had extended their lead in the final stages but McGregor held his ground to deny Jacobs before Lithgow struck the decisive blow from the bench.
rows.reference: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.

rows.source: Mai maye gurbi na Rangers twato Glenn Middleton ya sami wani neman ƙarshe na wani fenalti a inda ya yi ta ƙoƙarin tare da Jacobs amma Thomson ya kau da kai.
rows.output: The Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton was denied a late penalty after he tried to combine with Jacobs, but Thomson deflected it.
rows.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

rows.source: Kuma yanzu wani shafi ne daga "Sunday Morning" Almanac ɗinmu: 30 ga Satumba, 1882, shekaru 136 a yau, ana kuma CI GABA DA KIRGE ... ranar da aka haifi masanin ilmin yanayin duniya da zai so gaba Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger a cikin Jamus.
rows.output: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, it is also the birthday of the meteorologist who would later become famous for his invention of the Geiger counter, Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger in Germany.
rows.reference: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.

rows.output: Geiger built a method for detecting and measuring the conditions of radioactive activity, an invention that led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.

rows.output: A scientific laboratory, the Geiger Counter has become a relic of a bygone era, where in the 1950 film "Bells of Coronado," and in the television series "The Roy Rogers and Dale Evans Show," the scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans appeared as stars:

rows.output: A woman who was treated with an experimental vaccine, which teaches the body's immune system to recognize and attack cancer cells, has seen her cervical cancer disappear for more than 18 months.

rows.source: Hanyar ta hada ne da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jiki daga wani marar lafiya, inda ake gyara su a cikin dakin gwajin kimiyya yadda za su iya “ganin” wani sinadarin protein mai gina jiki da sankarori masu yawa suka sani da ake kira HER2, inda kuma ake sake shigar da su sel-sel din.
rows.output: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, where they are modified in a laboratory to be able to "see" a protein called HER2, which is known to be overexpressed in many types of cancer, and then reintroducing the cells into the patient.
rows.reference: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.

rows.source: Farfesa Jay Berzofsky, na Cibiyar Sankara ta Amurka da ke Bethesda, Maryland, ya ce: “Sakamakonmu yana nuna cewa da wata allura da za ta amfanar."
rows.output: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the Sankara American Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that there is a needle that will benefit."

rows.output: Professor Berzofsky said that HERS would "generate a wide range of tumors," including breast, uterus, lungs and liver.
rows.reference: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

rows.reference: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: Jerin girgizar kasa ya faru a yammacin tsibirin Sumatra a cikin karshen Maris da farkon Afrilu.
rows.output: 2005: A series of earthquakes occurred in western Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.reference: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.

rows.source: Daruruwa sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a bakin tekun Sumatra.
rows.output: Many people died on the island of Nias, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.reference: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: Girman 6.8 auku a kudancin Java, tsibirin da yafi kowanne cika a Indonesia, wanda ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shiga har kudancin bakin teku, inda ya kashe kusan mutane 700.
rows.output: 2006: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck southern Java, the most populous island in Indonesia, triggering a tsunami that affected the entire southern coast, killing about 700 people.
rows.reference: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.

rows.source: 2009: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.6 ta auku a kusa da birnin Padang, babban birnin lardin yammacin Sumatra.
rows.output: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake occurred near the city of Padang, the capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.reference: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.

rows.source: Fiye da mutane 1,100 aka kashe.
rows.output: More than 1,100 people have been killed.
rows.reference: More than 1,100 people were killed.

rows.source: 2010: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.5 ta auku a daya daga cikin tsibirin Mentawai, daga Sumatra, inda ta haifar da tsunami har zuwa mita 10 da suka lalata kananan garuruwa masu yawa kuma suka kashe kimanin mutane 300.
rows.output: 2010: A major earthquake of 7.5 magnitude occurred in one of the Mentawai Islands, off Sumatra, triggering a tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed several small villages and killed about 300 people.
rows.reference: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.

rows.source: 2016: Wani mummunan girgizar kasa ya auku a yankin Pidie Jaya a Aceh, ya haddasa rugurgujewar abubuwa da tsoro yayin da aka tunatar da mutane game da mummunan girgizar kasa da tsunami da ta auku a 2004.
rows.output: 2016: A devastating earthquake struck the Pidie Jaya region in Aceh, causing widespread damage and panic as people recalled the devastating earthquake and tsunami that occurred in 2004.
rows.reference: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.

rows.source: Ba a sami tsunami ba a wannan lokaci, amma fiye da mutane 100 suka mutu sakamakon gine-ginen da suka fadi.
rows.output: There was no tsunami in this case, but more than 100 people were killed by the collapsed buildings.
rows.reference: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.

rows.source: 2018: Babban girgizar kasar ya auku a tsibirin Lombok dake Indonesiya, inda ya kashe mutane sama da 500, mafi yawa a arewacin tsibirin.
rows.output: 2018: A major earthquake struck the island of Lombok in Indonesia, killing more than 500 people, most in the northern part of the island.
rows.reference: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.

rows.source: Girgizar ta ruguza dubban gine-gine kuma ta bar dubban masu 'yan yawon bude ido cikin wani hali na dan lokaci.
rows.output: The earthquake destroyed thousands of buildings and left many tourists in a state of temporary shock.
rows.reference: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.

rows.source: An kama babban dan Sarah Palin kan tuhumar rikicin cikin gida
rows.output: Sarah Palin's ex-husband, Todd Palin, arrested on domestic violence charges
rows.reference: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges

rows.source: Track Palin, babban dan tsohon gwanan Alaska kuma mataimakin shugaban dan takara Sarah Palin, an kama shi kan tuhumar cin zarafi.
rows.output: Track Palin, son of former Alaska governor and Republican vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on charges of domestic violence.
rows.reference: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.

rows.source: An kama Palin, mai shekaru 29, na Wasilla, Alaska, kan zargin da ake yi na tada hankalin cikin gida, tare da yin katsalandan ga rahotannin tada hankali cikin gida da, a cewar wani rahoton da Alaska State Troopers ta fitar, a ranar Asabar.
rows.output: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on Saturday for domestic violence, after allegedly assaulting a family member, according to a report by the Alaska State Troopers.
rows.reference: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.

rows.source: A cewar rahoton 'yan sanda, idan wata mata tayi kokarin ta kira' yan sanda don bayar da rahoton laifukan da ake zargin, sai ya dauki wayarta daga gareta
rows.output: According to the police report, if a woman tries to call the police to report alleged crimes, they take her phone away from her.
rows.reference: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.

rows.source: An sa Palin a cikin Mat-Su Pretrial Facility kuma ana gudanar da shi a kan yarjejeniyar takardar alkawali na $500, in ji KTUU.
rows.output: Palin was placed in the Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 personal recognizance bond, according to KTUU.
rows.reference: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.

rows.source: Ya bayyana a kotu a ranar Asabar, inda ya bayyana kansa "ba laifi ba, a gaskiya" lokacin da aka neme shi, ruwaitowar cibiyar sadarwa.
rows.output: He appeared in court on Saturday, where he described himself as "not guilty, in fact" when asked, according to the wire service.
rows.reference: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.

rows.source: Palin yana fuskantar nau'o'i uku na Aji na, ma'ana zai iya tsare shi har zuwa shekara guda kuma ya biya $ 250,000.
rows.output: Palin faces three classes of Class C, meaning he can be held for up to a year and pay $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.

rows.source: Ana kuma tuhuma shi da wani mummunan lakabi na Ajin B, wanda hukunci shi ne ya je kurkuku na rana guda da kuma tarar $2,000.
rows.output: He is also charged with a second count of Class B misdemeanor, which carries a sentence of one day in jail and a fine of $2,000.
rows.reference: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.

rows.source: Ba shi ne karo na farko da aka gurfanar da Palin ba akan mayan laifuka.
rows.output: It is not the first time that Palin has been charged with fraud.
rows.reference: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.

rows.source: A watan Disamba na shekara ta 2017, an zarge shi da kisa ga mahaifinsa, Todd Palin.
rows.output: In December 2017, he was accused of murdering his father, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.

rows.source: Mahaifiyarsa, Sarah Palin, ta kira 'yan sanda don bayar da rahoto game da harin.
rows.output: His mother, Sarah Palin, called the police to report the attack.
rows.reference: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.

rows.source: Shari’ar tana gaban Kotun Tsohon Kotun Alaska a yanzu haka.
rows.output: The case is currently before the Court of the Old Court of Alaska.
rows.reference: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.

rows.source: A watan Janairu 2016 an zargi shi da aikata laifuka na gida, da rikici da rahoto game da aikata ta'addanci a cikin gida, da kuma samun makamin yayin da yake cike da haɗari dangane da wannan lamarin.
rows.output: In January 2016, he was accused of domestic violence, conflict, and reporting on the commission of a crime in the home, and of having a weapon while in a dangerous situation related to this incident.
rows.reference: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.

rows.source: Budurwar shi ta yi zargin cewa ya doke ta a fuska.
rows.output: She accused him of hitting her in the face.
rows.reference: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.

rows.source: An soki Sarah Palin a lamarin ta hanyar kungiyoyin tsofaffin soja a shekara ta 2016 bayan ya haɗu da halayyar danginta ga PTSD daga aikinsa a Iraki.
rows.output: Sarah Palin was criticized in 2016 by a group of former military personnel after she associated her family's behavior with PTSD from her service in Iraq.
rows.reference: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.

rows.source: Girgizar kasar Indonesia ta tsunami: daruruwa sun mutu
rows.output: Indonesia's earthquake and tsunami: thousands dead
rows.reference: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed

rows.source: Akalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu bayan girgizar kasa ta mamaye tsibirin Sulawesi a Indonesia a ranar Juma’a.
rows.output: At least 384 people have died after a tsunami hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.reference: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.

rows.source: Girgizar kasa mai magnitude 7.5 ya haifar da tsunami kuma ya rushe dubban gidajen.
rows.output: A 7.5-magnitude earthquake caused a tsunami and destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.reference: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.

rows.source: Harkokin lantarki da sadarwar sun lalace tare da tsammani karin matattu za' tashi a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.output: The electrical and communication systems have been damaged, and more casualties are expected in the coming days.
rows.reference: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.

rows.source: Girgizar ta fara ne kawai daga tsakiyar Sulawesi wanda ke arewa maso gabashin kasar Indonesia, Jakarta.
rows.output: The tremor began first from the center of Sulawesi, which is located in the northern part of Indonesia, Jakarta.
rows.reference: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.

rows.source: Bidio na ta yawu a shafukan watsa labarai na nuna lokacin tasiri.
rows.output: The video is widely available on news websites, showing the impact.
rows.reference: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.

rows.source: Daruruwan mutane sun taru don bikin rairayin bakin teku a birnin Palu lokacin da tsunami ya rushe a bakin tekun.
rows.output: Tens of thousands of people gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami struck the coast.
rows.reference: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.

rows.source: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya na neman hukuncin kisa na kisa ga dan ta’adda NYC
rows.output: The federal prosecutors are seeking the death penalty for the NYC bomber
rows.reference: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect

rows.source: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya a birnin New York suna neman hukuncin kisa ga Sayfullo Saipov, wanda ake zargin a harin da ya faru a birnin New York, wanda ya kashe mutane takwas - hukuncin da ba a yi ba a jihar don aikata laifukan tarayya tun shekara ta 1953.
rows.output: The federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, who is accused of the attack in New York City, which killed eight people - a sentence that has not been carried out in the state for federal crimes since 1953.
rows.reference: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi amfani da motoci mai hawa na gida domin gudanar da hare-haren kan hanyar machine da ta hanyar West Side Highway a Lower Manhattan, inda ya kaddamar akan masu tafiya a kafa da kekuna a hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.
rows.output: Saipov, 30, used a rental truck to carry out the attack on the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, where he targeted pedestrians and cyclists in his path in October.
rows.reference: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.

rows.source: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su tabbatar da cewa Saipov "da gangan" ya kashe mutane takwas da "ganganci" ya jawo mummunan rauni a jiki, bisa ga sanarwar na neman hukuncin kisa, aka a yankin Kudancin Sabon Gundumar New York.
rows.output: To confirm the death penalty, the prosecutors will prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed eight people and "intentionally" caused serious physical injury to others, according to the notice of the death penalty, in the Southern District of New York.
rows.reference: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.

rows.source: Dukkan waɗanda nan la'akari su na da hukuncin kisa, bisa ga takardun kotu.
rows.output: All those considered for the death penalty, according to court documents.
rows.reference: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.

rows.source: Makonni bayan harin, babban kotun tarayya ta maka wa Saipov zarge-zarge 22 da suka hada da laifuffuka guda takwas na kisan kai don taimakon rashin gaskiya, yawanci sune masu gabatar da kara ke yi a laifukan shiryeyyen laifi, da kuma cajin tashin hankali da halakar da motoci.
rows.output: A week after the attack, the federal court in Manhattan charged Saipov with 22 counts, including eight counts of murder in the first degree for terrorism, typically brought by prosecutors in death penalty cases, and conspiracy to commit terrorism and destruction of vehicles.
rows.reference: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.

rows.source: Wannan harin ya bukaci "tsarawa mai mahimmanci da kaddamarwa," in ji masu gabatar da kara, inda ya bayyana irin yadda Saipov ya dauki shi a matsayin "mai mugunta, mummunan hali da kuma marar sa tausayi."
rows.output: This attack required "a high level of planning and execution," according to the prosecutors, who described the way Saipov took it on as "a cowardly, despicable act and a cold-blooded murder."
rows.reference: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwa na niyyar jihohi.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwa na niyyar jihohi.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.

rows.source: Biyar daga cikin waɗanda aka kashe 'yan yawon bude ido daga Argentina
rows.output: Four of those killed were tourists from Argentina
rows.reference: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.

rows.source: An yi shekaru goma tun lokacin da yankin kudancin New York ya kaddamar da hukuncin kisa.
rows.output: Ten years have passed since the southern New York region implemented the death penalty.
rows.reference: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.

rows.source: Wanda aka gurfanar da shi, Khalid Barnes, an yanke masa hukunci ne game da kashe masu raba kwaya biyu, amma an yanke masa hukuncin kisa a watan Satumba na 2009.
rows.output: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was sentenced to death for the murders of two drug dealers, but the sentence was commuted to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.reference: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.

rows.source: karshen a lokacin da aka yanke hukuncin kisa a tarayya New York a 1953 ga Julius da Ethel Rosenberg, ma'aurata bayan da aka yanke musu hukuncin kulla makirci don Tarayyar Soviet a lokacin Yakin Tsana shekaru biyu da suka gabata.
rows.output: The end of the era of capital punishment in the United States came in 1953 with the execution of Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple who were sentenced to death for conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War, two years earlier.
rows.reference: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.

rows.source: Dukansu Rosenbergs sun mutu ne ta hanyar kujerar lantarki ranar 19 ga Yuni, 1953.
rows.output: Both Rosenbergs were executed by electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.reference: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, dan kasar Uzbekistan, ya nuna rashin tausayi a cikin kwanaki da watanni bayan harin, bisa ga takardun kotu.
rows.output: Saipov, a citizen of Uzbekistan, expressed remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.reference: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.

rows.source: Ya bayyana wa masu binciken cewa ya jin daɗin abin da ya yi, 'yan sanda sun ce.
rows.output: He told the investigators that he enjoyed what he did, the police said.
rows.reference: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.

rows.source: Saipov ya shaida wa hukumomin da cewa ya samu kwarin guiwa bayan gudanar da harin bayan ya duba bidiyon ISIS a wayarsa, bisa ga zargin.
rows.output: Saipov told investigators that he felt invigorated after the attack after watching an ISIS video on his phone, according to the charges.
rows.reference: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.

rows.source: Har ila yau, ya bukaci a nuna tutar Isis a cikin dakin asibiti, in ji 'yan sanda.
rows.output: In addition, he requested that the Isis flag be displayed in the hospital room, police said.
rows.reference: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.

rows.source: Ya yi zargin ba shi da laifi ga tuhuma 22 na zargin.
rows.output: He pleaded not guilty to charges 22 of allegations.
rows.reference: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.

rows.source: David Patton, daya daga cikin masu kare hakkin jama'a na tarayya a jihar Saipov, ya ce su na da "takaici" tare da yanke shawara.
rows.output: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders in the Saipov case, said they were "disappointed" with the ruling.
rows.reference: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.

rows.source: "Mu na tsammanin shawarar da za a nemi hukuncin kisa maimakon karɓar laifin mai laifi zuwa rai a kurkuku ba tare da yiwuwar saki ba zai shawo kan matsalolin abubuwan da ke faruwa ga kowa da kowa", inji Patton.
rows.output: "We expect that the decision to seek the death penalty instead of accepting the guilty plea of the perpetrator, who will be sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole, will address the problems of the situation for everyone," said Patton.
rows.reference: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.

rows.source: Lauyoyi masu kare Saipov sun nemi masu gabatar da kara kada su nemi hukuncin kisa.
rows.output: The lawyers for Saipov's defense have requested the prosecution not to seek the death penalty.
rows.reference: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.

rows.source: Tory MP ya ce NIGEL FARAGE ya kamata a kula da tattaunawar Brexit
rows.output: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be held responsible for the Brexit talks
rows.reference: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations

rows.source: Nigel Farage ya yi alwashin yin 'yan tawaye a yau yayin zanga-zanga a taron Tory.
rows.output: Nigel Farage has promised to make a series of "defiant" speeches today during Tory protests.
rows.reference: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.

rows.source: Tsohon shugaban Ukip ya ce 'yan siyasar sun' ji zafi 'daga' yan kasuwa na Eurosceptics - kamar yadda daya daga cikin wakilai na Theresa May ta ba da shawara cewa ya kamata tayi la'akari da tattaunawar da EU.
rows.output: Former Ukip leader Nigel Farage said the politicians had "got their noses out of joint" from Eurosceptic business people - as one of Theresa May's representatives suggested she should consider talking to the EU.
rows.reference: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.

rows.source: Wani mai goyon baya na baya-bayan nan, Peter Bone, ya shaida wa manema labaru a Birmingham cewa Birtaniya za ta fita daga yanzu idan Mr Farage ya zama Sakatare Brexit.
rows.output: A recent supporter, Peter Bone, told reporters in Birmingham that Britain would now leave the EU if Mr. Farage became the Brexit Secretary.
rows.reference: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.

rows.source: Amma ƙalubalen da Mrs May ta fuskanta wajen sulhu da ragamar da aka yi a tsakanin bangarori daban-daban da aka yi sun nuna cewa, Pro-Remain Tories na shiga cikin rashin amincewa da Brexit a birnin.
rows.output: But the challenges faced by Mrs May in negotiating the terms of the Brexit deal made between different factions within the party have shown that, pro-Remain Tory MPs are entering into a state of disarray in the city.
rows.reference: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.

rows.source: Fremiya na fama da matsalolin kulawa da masu bincikenta sunyi shiri akan hanya a cikin hare-hare daga Brexiteers, Remainers da EU.
rows.output: Fremya is struggling with care issues and her researchers have been preparing for attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers, and the EU.
rows.reference: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.

rows.source: Abokai sun dage cewa ta tura gaba tare da ƙoƙarina buga yarjejeniyar tare da Brussels duk da sakamakon - kuma ta tilasta yan Turai da Labour don su zabi tsakaninta da 'rudani'.
rows.output: Friends insisted that she push ahead with my efforts to sign a deal with Brussels despite the outcome - and force the Europeans and the Labour Party to choose between her and 'chaos'.
rows.reference: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.

rows.source: Mista Bone ya shaida wa kamfanin dillancin labaran AFP cewa, yana son 'duba' 'Masu binciken'.
rows.output: Mr. Bone told the news agency AFP that he wanted to "see" the "investigators".
rows.reference: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.

rows.source: Ya ba da shawarar cewa Mr Farage ya kamata ya zama dan takara kuma ya ba da alhakin tattaunawar da Brussels.
rows.output: He suggested that Mr. Farage should be a candidate and take responsibility for the negotiations with Brussels.
rows.reference: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.

rows.source: "In da ya kasance mai kula, da yanzu mun fita," in ji shi.
rows.output: "He was a good man, but now we are in trouble," he said.
rows.reference: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.

rows.source: The Wellingborough MP ya kara: 'Zan tsaya a kan Brexit amma mu na buƙatar mu duba masu bincike.'
rows.output: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand on Brexit but we need to look at the experts.'
rows.reference: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'

rows.source: Da yake nuna adawa da EU, ya ce: 'Ba mu yi yaƙe-yaƙe na duniya ba don mu zama kaskantattu.
rows.output: As he expressed his opposition to the EU, he said: "We did not fight two world wars to become subservient.
rows.reference: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.

rows.source: Mu na son yin dokokinmu a ƙasar mu.’'
rows.output: We want to make our own laws in our country.''
rows.reference: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'

rows.output: In the past eight years, I have been the Labour MP for the area, and the Friday night GC meeting is usually the one I attend.

rows.source: Na mwute taa, ọ bụghị olu nke imirikiti nzụkọ yana ndọrọndọrọ “obi ọma, ume ala” ekwere na nkwa bụ ihe ndị echefugoro kemgbe ma ọ bụrụ, n’ezie, o bidoro ma ncha.
rows.output: Unfortunately, today, it is not the voice of the majority that is heard, and the "good intentions, deep breaths" that were promised have been forgotten since, if at all, they were ever really initiated and maintained.

rows.source: Ọ bụ ihe pụtara ihie nke ukwuu na anaghị anabata nghọta dị iche iche na ndọrọndọrọ Labour, ọzọkwa a na ekpezi echiche ọ bụla ma a ga-anabata ya n’ọchịchị ndọrọndọrọ ahụ.
rows.output: It is a very significant issue that the Labour Party does not accept different interpretations of its policies, and any opinion will be accepted in the party's governance.
rows.reference: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.

rows.source: Nke a bidoro ozugbo Jeremy bụrụ onye isi, ndị ọrụ ibe m, ndị m chere na mụ na ha na ekekọrịta otu nghọta ndọrọndọrọ bidoro tụba anya na m ga-atụgharị ozugbo ma were ọnọdụ ndị m ga-agaghị ekwekọrịta na ya otu ọ bụla - ma ọ bụ na nchedo obodo ma ọ bụ otu ahịa EU.
rows.output: This began immediately when Jeremy became leader, my colleagues, with whom I thought I shared a common understanding of the political situation, began to look at me as someone who would turn around and take a position that I would never agree with on any issue - either national security or the EU market.
rows.reference: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.

rows.source: Mgbe ọ bụla m kwuru okwu n’ọhaneze - ọ gaghị agbasata ihe m kwuru - a na enwe nkwụtọ dị ukwuu na esote ozugbo n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze na akpọ maka mwepu, nkatọ ndọrọndọrọ nke etiti, na agwa m na m ekwesịghị ịnọ na ndọrọndọrọ Labour.
rows.output: Whenever I speak in public - it will not be based on what I said - there is a significant backlash that follows immediately in the media and calls for my removal, criticism of the party's center, and my character that I should not be in the Labour Party.
rows.reference: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.

rows.source: Ma nke a abụghị naanị m.
rows.output: But this is not just about me.

rows.source: N’ezie, ama m na m ka nwee ihu ọma karịa ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ibe m n’ihi asịsa ndị ezitere m na abụkarị maka ndọrọndọrọ.
rows.output: Of course, I know that I have been more fortunate than some of my colleagues because I have been sent to some of the most difficult places and have often been involved in political matters.
rows.reference: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.

rows.source: Enwere m ntụmanya n’arụmọrụ na mkpebi nke ndị ọrụ ibe m ndị ahụ na enweta nkatọ okike mmadụ ma ọ bụ agbụrụ ya kwa ụbọchị mana ha anaghị agba ọsọ.
rows.output: I have high expectations for the performance and decisions of my colleagues, who are constantly receiving criticism of their humanity or race, but they are not running away.

rows.source: Otu n’ime akụkụ kachasị ada mmụọ nke oge ndọrọndọrọ a bụ otu okwu nkatọ ndị jọrọ njọ si buru ihe nkịtị.
rows.output: One of the most depressing aspects of this era is the way in which some of the most vicious criticisms have become so commonplace.
rows.reference: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.

rows.output: I've had a lot of advice over the past two years to get my head out of the sand, to stop talking so much and just get on with it.

rows.source: Mana nke ahụ abụghị ihe m banyere ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị ịme.

rows.source: Kemgbe m sonyere Labour afọ 32 ka nwa akwụkwọ, nke nlegharị anya gọọmentị Thatcher kpalitere, nke hapụrụ ime ụlọ akwụkwọ m na nnukwu mmebi, achọrọ m na mbụ idu ọrụ mara mma nke ọhaneze maka ndị kachasị chọọ ha - ma abụ m onye ndu obere mpaghara ma ọ bụ minista gọọmentị.
rows.output: Since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a student, the Thatcher government's cuts have left my school in a state of disrepair, I have always wanted a good public service for those who need it most - and I have been a local leader or government minister.
rows.reference: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.

rows.source: Ezobeghị m ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị m na mbụ, gụnyere ntuli aka ikpeazụ.
rows.output: I have not been involved in politics before, including the last election.
rows.reference: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.

rows.source: Ọnweghị onye ọ bụla nọ na Nottingham East ga-enwe mgbagwoju anya gbasara ọnọdụ iwu m yana mpaghara ndị mụ ekwenyeghị n’ọchịchị dị ugbu a.

rows.source: Maka ndị ahụ kwadoro ụkpụrụ ahụ na Fraịde, ihe niile m nwere ike ikwu bụ na mgbe obodo na aga ịnwe Brexit ga-enwe mmetụta adịghị mma n’ọtụtụ ezinụlọ, azụmahịa na ọrụ ọhaneze anyị, aghọtaghị m agụụ iji gbuo oge na ike maka nkwado m na ndị isi ndọrọndọrọ Labour.
rows.output: For those who supported the motion on Friday, all I can say is that when the country goes for Brexit, it will have a negative impact on many families, businesses, and public services, and I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy in supporting the motion and the Labour leadership.
rows.reference: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.

rows.source: Mana n’eziokwu otu ozi m nwere abụghị maka Nottingham Momentum, ọ bụ maka ndị mmebe m, ma ọ bụ ndị otu Labour ma ha abụghị: Enwere m afọ ojuju ijere unu ozi ma na ekwe nkwa na ọnweghị ihe egwu mwepu ole ma ọ bụ ngwangwa ndọrọndọrọ ga-akwụsị m ịme ihe m kwere kachasị dịịrị unu niile mma.
rows.output: But one message I want to convey is not about Nottingham Momentum, it's about my makers, or the Labour Party if they are not: I am satisfied to serve you and I promise that no threat of expulsion or any other political gimmick will stop me from doing what I believe is best for all of you.
rows.reference: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.

rows.source: Ọ bụ omenala ugbu a ịchọ mkpa Brexit n’ihe nkiri ọhụrụ ọ bụla nwere nribama Britain, na nke a dịka ọ metụtara mmegharị ihe nkiri ịkpa ọchị nke Johnny English - bụ nke ejiri Johnny English malite na 2003, wee laghachikwa azụ na 2011 ka Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: It is now a tradition to seek a Brexit angle in every new film with a British cast, and this one is no exception as it relates to the Johnny English comedy franchise - which was initiated by Johnny English in 2003, and then returned in 2011 as Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.

rows.output: It seems that the film's comedic theme of how we became the broken ones has become a new marketing channel for us?

rows.output: However, the clumsy, one-eyed Johnny English plastic face has once again reinvented his ability to promote something - his name more than anything else shows that it is a comedic invention made for the non-English speaking parts of the world.

rows.source: N’ezie ọ bụ onye iberibe ọrụ nzuzo nke agbanyeghị ṅṅomi ya gbagwojuru anya, nwere obere Clouseau, ntakịrị Mr Bean na nfechalụ nke nwoke ahụ n’etinye otu olu na isiokwu Chariots of Fire na mmalite mmemme Olympics London 2012.

rows.output: Atkinson's gift for slapstick comedy is evident, but the comedy is weak and overdone, overshadowing the films' "non-comedic" elements, such as the 007 and Mission Impossible franchises, which now have a dash of comedy within them.
rows.reference: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.

rows.output: This group of workers is demanding that company executives transfer their accumulated wealth to the workers through a sit-in protest that will not end until they receive a day off.

rows.output: He will make the workers work for three days a week and pay them the same salary.

rows.output: The spokespersons for the opposition said that this "would be a setback" for the party's economic plans to make the workers more dependent.
rows.reference: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.

rows.output: The Trade Union Congress has endorsed a four-day workweek as a way for workers to gain a better balance between work and life in a changing economy.
rows.reference: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.

rows.output: The Labour Party's spokesperson for parliamentary affairs told the Sunday Times: 'We expect to announce a policy review before the end of the year.
rows.reference: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.

rows.source: ‘Ọ gaghị eme ozugbo mana ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu bụ ebumnobi ndị otu a dabara n’usoro ihazi akụnụba ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ yana mkpokota ụzọ nrụpụta ihe nke ndị otu ahụ.’
rows.output: 'It won't be immediate, but working four days a week is the goal of this group, which is in line with the economic organization of the workers and the total production methods of the group.'

rows.output: The Labour Party does not currently support the goal as a party, regardless of the circumstances.

rows.reference: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell jiri ọgbakọ Labour mere izu gara aga were kọwapụta echiche ya maka mgbanwe na akụnụba.
rows.output: The Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used the Labour Party conference last week to outline his ideas for changing the economy.
rows.reference: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.

rows.output: Mr. McDonnell said he decided to reclaim the right from "unknown corporate insiders" and "excessive profit recipients" in companies that are used for personal gain.
rows.reference: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.

rows.source: Atụmatụ shadow chancellor ahụ pụtakwara na ndị nwere oke n’ụlọ ọrụ mmiri nwere ike ha agaghị enwetacha isi ego ha, maka gọọmentị Labour nwere ike ‘ime mwepu’ na ndabere ebumnobi ihe ezighi ezi.
rows.output: The shadow chancellor's plans also indicated that those with a stake in the water industry may not receive their expected dividends, as the Labour government might 'make cuts' in the basis for incorrect expectations.
rows.reference: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.

rows.source: O kwuputakwara atụmatụ itinye ndị ọrụ na bọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ma mepụta Inclusive Ownership Fund ga-enyefe pesenti 10 n’oke ụlọ ọrụ ndị nkịtị n’aka ndị ọrụ, ndị nwere ike inweta uru isi ego ruru £500.
rows.output: He also announced plans to put workers on the boards of companies and create an Inclusive Ownership Fund that would transfer 10 percent of the shares of publicly traded companies to workers, who could be eligible for up to £500 in dividends.
rows.reference: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.
